title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform Integration, Robot Software
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams Wayve’s Robot Software group turns new vehicle programs into stable, reliable robot systems. The Platform Integration team works at the boundary between onboard software and vehicle hardware, bringing up new platforms while building reusable components and frameworks that make every future integration faster and more predictable. As a Software Engineer on the Platform Integration team, you’ll combine hands-on vehicle and bench work with production software development. Your work will directly enable safe, scalable deployment across multiple vehicle programs. 🧠 Your day-to-day Support software bring-up on benches, HiL systems, and vehicles, including work at international test locations. Develop and maintain vehicle-facing software components and shared frameworks. Diagnose integration issues across software and hardware boundaries and drive them through resolution. Identify architectural improvements that reduce bespoke work and improve reuse. Build diagnostics, tooling, and metrics for robot-software reliability and performance. Produce clear documentation and runbooks for long-term supportability. Collaborate with hardware, safety, controls, calibration, and reliability teams. 🧩 What you’ll be working on New vehicle-program bring-up across embedded compute, sensors, networks, and software services. Linux-based robotic and automotive systems with multi-process and distributed architectures. ROS2 or similar middleware, node development, message interfaces, and system integration. Sensor calibration, synchronisation, data validation, and system-level debugging. Automotive-grade compute platforms such as NVIDIA DRIVE and Qualcomm Snapdragon Ride. Vehicle communication systems including CAN and Automotive Ethernet. Shared abstractions and frameworks that improve reliability across programs. 🙌 You should apply if You have strong software-development experience in C++, Python, or Rust. You have delivered production-quality software on Linux-based robotic, embedded, or automotive platforms. You understand ROS2 or similar robotics middleware and distributed-system integration. You have hands-on experience integrating software with vehicle or embedded hardware. You can diagnose complex problems using logs, telemetry, on-target tests, and systematic experimentation. You understand vehicle sensors, networking, and the practical realities of platform bring-up. Experience with drive-by-wire systems, CAN tools, shared frameworks, HiL or simulation, functional safety, technical documentation, or observability would be valuable. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Wayve’s Robot Software group turns new vehicle programs into stable, reliable robot systems. The Platform Integration team works at the boundary between onboard software and vehicle hardware, bringing up new platforms while building reusable components and frameworks that make every future integration faster and more predictable.

As a Software Engineer on the Platform Integration team, you’ll combine hands-on vehicle and bench work with production software development. Your work will directly enable safe, scalable deployment across multiple vehicle programs.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Support software bring-up on benches, HiL systems, and vehicles, including work at international test locations.

  • Develop and maintain vehicle-facing software components and shared frameworks.

  • Diagnose integration issues across software and hardware boundaries and drive them through resolution.

  • Identify architectural improvements that reduce bespoke work and improve reuse.

  • Build diagnostics, tooling, and metrics for robot-software reliability and performance.

  • Produce clear documentation and runbooks for long-term supportability.

  • Collaborate with hardware, safety, controls, calibration, and reliability teams.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • New vehicle-program bring-up across embedded compute, sensors, networks, and software services.

  • Linux-based robotic and automotive systems with multi-process and distributed architectures.

  • ROS2 or similar middleware, node development, message interfaces, and system integration.

  • Sensor calibration, synchronisation, data validation, and system-level debugging.

  • Automotive-grade compute platforms such as NVIDIA DRIVE and Qualcomm Snapdragon Ride.

  • Vehicle communication systems including CAN and Automotive Ethernet.

  • Shared abstractions and frameworks that improve reliability across programs.

 

🙌 You should apply if

  • You have strong software-development experience in C++, Python, or Rust.

  • You have delivered production-quality software on Linux-based robotic, embedded, or automotive platforms.

  • You understand ROS2 or similar robotics middleware and distributed-system integration.

  • You have hands-on experience integrating software with vehicle or embedded hardware.

  • You can diagnose complex problems using logs, telemetry, on-target tests, and systematic experimentation.

  • You understand vehicle sensors, networking, and the practical realities of platform bring-up.

Experience with drive-by-wire systems, CAN tools, shared frameworks, HiL or simulation, functional safety, technical documentation, or observability would be valuable.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial recruiter screen — 25 mins

  • Competency Interviews — Programming and technical domain (2 hours)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews — Programming, software design, and hiring-manager/team fit (3 hours)

  • Final interview — Mission and values alignment (30 mins)

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen

  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen

  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln

  • Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen

  • Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden

  • Unsere zwei Auszubildenden im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)

  • Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für unsere Azubis eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)

  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID

  • Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework

  • Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.

  • JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab

  • Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL

  • Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD

  • Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1

  • Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch

  • Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.

  • Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen bei uns genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design

title: Graduate Technology Strategy Analyst, Physical Sciences / Engineering (2027 start)
description:
Introduction

Are you a recent or soon-to-be graduate in chemistry, physics, engineering or a related field, excited to put your scientific knowledge and curiosity to work on real-world business issues? Are you interested in understanding why some scientific breakthroughs change the world, while other promising technologies struggle to make it into everyday life? Are you fascinated by how things are made, how people use them and how we can shape a more sustainable future?

Do you enjoy exploring complex questions, making connections between ideas and working with others to find thoughtful, practical solutions? Would you like to help businesses understand not just what technology can do, but how it can make a meaningful difference?
If so, this could be a great role for you!
 

Who we are

A key part of Cambridge Consultants, our Advisory team works with clients across Consumer, Energy & Industrial, Telecommunications, Biotech, Healthcare and Defence & Security. Our clients range from early start-ups to global organisations, all looking for ways to use emerging technologies to address challenges, create new possibilities and make a positive impact in their markets.
Our role is to help them navigate uncertainty, explore opportunities and turn promising ideas into practical outcomes.
We provide research and insights to support important business choices relating to deep tech. This includes go-to-market strategies, investment support, competitor analysis, market insights, technology road-mapping and strategic foresight. The technologies we explore span exciting developments in biotech, quantum sensing and computing, robotics and physical AI, among many others.
 

Your role

This role sits within the Research & Insights section of our Advisory group. We explore how emerging technologies and future trends might shape the choices businesses make today, helping our clients feel better equipped to navigate change and plan for the future.
You might investigate what people will value in the next generation of products, explore how cleantech can be adopted at scale, or uncover where novel sensors could create new possibilities for businesses and their customers.
It's an opportunity to combine scientific thinking, creative exploration and commercial understanding to help answer questions that don't always have straightforward answers.
 

What you will be doing

With guidance and support from our wider Advisory team, you will:
  • Explore a variety of meaningful projects spanning climate tech investment, new energy generation, smart mobility strategy and emerging deep tech fields such as quantum.
  • Bring fresh perspectives to complex challenges, drawing on different research approaches and ideas to help clients identify opportunities across products, services and operations, including AI-enabled approaches.
  • Work collaboratively with specialists in engineering, science, product design and realisation, and business to develop strategies that create commercial and societal benefits.
  • Make sense of complex information, analysing markets, technologies and business models to help clients understand their options, consider potential challenges and drive informed actions.
  • Share ideas and contribute to thought leadership on how deep tech could help address global challenges, from communication on the moon to the future of repairable consumer devices.

 

What you can bring

 
We are looking for applicants with the following traits and skills: 
  • A relevant academic background: A Master's or PhD in physical sciences, maths, data science, engineering or another related discipline.
  • Business and commercial thinking: Experience or an interest in entrepreneurship, business or economics, whether through student business plan competitions, internships, start-ups or relevant modules and further study.
  • Thoughtful analytical and creative thinking: The ability to explore complex technical ideas, recognise connections and turn findings into clear, practical recommendations.
  • Curiosity and adaptability: Enthusiasm for learning about new technologies, exploring different sectors and approaching unfamiliar challenges with an open mind.
  • Communication and collaboration: The ability to explain complex ideas clearly, listen to different perspectives and build constructive relationships with people from a range of technical and professional backgrounds.

 

How to apply

If this opportunity interests you, please send your CV and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience, interests and what excites you about the role.
We welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. You don't need to meet every requirement to be a strong candidate. If the role sparks your curiosity and you'd enjoy exploring how science and technology can make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Technical Product Manager, Developer Experience & Product-Led Growth
description:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

The Role

We're looking for a highly technical Product Manager to own how developers discover, build on and grow with Telnyx.

Telnyx operates a global infrastructure platform spanning communications, AI inference, GPUs, edge compute, databases and real-time applications. We've invested heavily in building the underlying infrastructure. Now we want to make it dramatically easier for developers to understand what's possible, build useful applications and get into production.

This is a hands-on product role leading a small team of six engineers across Developer Relations and Product-Led Growth. We aren't looking for a traditional DevRel leader or someone whose primary skill is managing people. We want a strong engineer with excellent product judgment who understands developer experience, builds things personally and knows how to turn developer adoption into revenue. 

The Team

You'll lead a team of six: three DevRel engineers (sample apps, open source, technical content and demos) and three PLG engineers (activation, AI agents and automation, self-service conversion and expansion). You'll report to the Chief Operating Officer. 

What you'll own

  • Build applications developers actually want to use — Lead the DevRel team in building production-quality sample applications, integrations, templates and reference implementations on Telnyx. Publish them on GitHub, maintain them and make them easy for developers to deploy and extend. Turn those applications into compelling technical content, live demos and developer distribution.
  • Drive product-led growth — Own the PLG operation responsible for moving developers from signup to meaningful usage and revenue. Use product telemetry, behavioral signals, AI agents and human intervention to identify friction, accelerate onboarding, improve conversion and expand self-service usage.
  • Make the developer experience better — Get hands-on with our APIs, SDKs, documentation and infrastructure. Work directly with product engineering to identify and resolve the issues that make products difficult to use. Our reference applications should continuously test whether our products are genuinely ready for developers.
  • Build AI-native growth systems — Work with Growth Engineering and RevOps to develop automated workflows for developer acquisition, onboarding, account intelligence, technical assistance and expansion. We believe small teams of excellent technical people supervising powerful automation can outperform much larger traditional GTM organizations.
  • Connect the entire developer journey — Applications attract developers. Developers experiment with the platform. PLG helps them succeed. Production usage generates revenue. The feedback from that process improves our products and informs what we build next. You'll be accountable for making that system work. .

What we're looking for

  • A strong software engineering background. You should be comfortable building and debugging real applications, working with APIs, reading code and understanding complex infrastructure.
  • Experience as a Technical Product Manager, founding engineer, technical founder or similar role with substantial personal responsibility for shipping software.
  • Exceptional product judgment, particularly around developer tools, APIs, documentation, onboarding and usability.
  • Familiarity with AI infrastructure, LLMs, inference, cloud platforms, real-time systems or developer infrastructure.
  • Understanding of product-led growth, including developer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention and monetization.
  • Ability to work with AI coding agents, automation frameworks, product analytics and modern developer tooling.
  • Strong technical communication skills. You can explain complicated technologies clearly and recognize what makes a useful demonstration or reference application.
  • Comfortable leading a small technical team while remaining deeply involved in the actual work.

Experience at a developer infrastructure company is valuable. Experience personally building and growing something developers love is more important.

How we'll measure success

Your primary objective is growing developer-led revenue on Telnyx.

We'll look at activated developers, production applications deployed, self-service conversion, usage expansion and retention. We'll also measure the adoption of our reference applications, how effectively our developer content attracts users and how quickly developers can get from signup to a working application.

We care about applications developers actually use, not demos shipped for the sake of demos. We care about developers reaching production, not just generating signups. And we care about revenue, not vanity metrics.

Who will thrive here

Someone who would rather build a working prototype than spend a week debating a roadmap. Someone who notices a broken onboarding experience and immediately starts fixing it. Someone who understands both what makes infrastructure technically excellent and what makes developers want to use it.

You should be capable of leading six very technical people because you have the engineering ability, product instincts and judgment to make everyone around you more effective.

This is a builder's job, not a professional management job.

We're looking for someone who can make Telnyx a platform developers genuinely love building on, and turn that into a meaningful business.

Unser Human Risk Management-Ansatz unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, ihre Mitarbeiter*innen zum wirkungsvollsten Schutzschild gegen Sicherheitsrisiken zu entwickeln. Mit der Unterstützung führender VCs wie Highland Europe und Global Founders Capital expandieren wir weltweit in rasantem Tempo. Wir suchen Teamplayer, die sinnvolle Veränderungen im Bereich Cybersicherheit vorantreiben, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen wollen. Your Role

As a Defect Inspection Engineer/Expert, you will be responsible for ensuring the defect-free quality of semiconductor wafers using Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems and unpatterned wafer inspection.

You will detect defects such as particles, scratches, haze, and surface roughness that could impact the yield of our integrated graphene photonics process flow. Working in a cleanroom environment, you will collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams to set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve defect detection and classification.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection on materials such as bare silicon, epitaxial layers and polished wafers

  • Set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes

  • Fine-tune inspection tool and recipe parameters to improve defect-detection sensitivity, inspection quality, repeatability and overall performance

  • Analyze defect data to identify trends, root causes and potential process excursions

  • Interpret defect data and translate findings into actionable insights for process teams

  • Generate defect maps, Pareto charts and reports to communicate findings

  • Participate in Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize inspection parameters

  • Troubleshoot inspection-related issues and support continuous improvement in defect detection and classification

  • Collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams

What You Bring

  • A bachelor’s degree or above in electrical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field

  • 5+ years of experience in semiconductor inspection, with a focus on AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection

  • Hands-on experience with unpatterned wafer inspection systems, such as SPx, and AOI tools such as Eagle or Dragonfly

  • Understanding of semiconductor process flows, including polishing, epitaxy and cleaning

  • Familiarity with defect classification, SEM review and Statistical Process Control (SPC)

  • Proficiency in AOI and defect-review software, such as KLA Klarity and Camtek Inspecta

  • Ability to optimize inspection tools and recipe parameters for sensitivity, inspection quality and repeatability

  • Ability to interpret defect data and identify relevant trends and improvement opportunities

  • Proficiency in JMP for statistical analysis, data visualization and DOE

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

  • Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

 

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in RevOps / Sales Ops / Sales Effectiveness, several of them spent hands-on building the sales machine. You own initiatives end-to-end (scope, design, build, measure);

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives;

  • Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Can write and own SQL queries yourself (joins, basic data modeling), not just read them.

  • Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

  • Have configured Salesforce yourself (objects, fields, flows) and can say what you personally built vs. what an integrator or another team did.

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have at least an advanced level in English.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

title: Brand Marketing Lead
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We're looking for a Brand Marketing Lead to join our Brand & Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help own our brand marketing strategy and campaign execution across six European markets and be part of our marketing team as we scale our spend management platform. If you're excited about building category-defining campaigns that move Pleo from a good solution to the undisputed choice for mid-market finance leaders and are passionate about brand strategy and creative execution, then this is the opportunity for you! Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to the Director of Integrated Marketing, and work in close collaboration with the Director of Brand Experience and Strategy, as well as the Brand Intelligence Manager, our brand foundations team, PR, content marketing and digital channels team. You’ll partner cross-functionally with PMM, MOPS, CX and sales. This is a hands-on, IC role, where you'll do both the thinking and the work—strategy and execution both sit with you. What you’ll be doing As a Brand Marketing Lead, you will: Own the brand marketing strategy that moves Pleo from ‘one of many’ to the undisputed choice for mid-market European finance leaders. Build and execute integrated brand campaigns from concept through to reporting — learning from what we’ve just launched, and pushing further. Create branded content that shows how financial services should be done. Content that recognizes the precision, rigor, and craft that finance leaders bring to their work. Manage the funnel strategically — balancing awareness, consideration, and conversion. Not just fishing in the pond of people who already know us, but earning the right to speak to people we don’t know yet. Own your budget and agency relationships — you’re the strategic partner they answer to. Measure what matters — working with Brand Intelligence, Integrated Marketing, Data, and MOps to track brand lift, earned media, consideration, and how brand work flows into pipeline and revenue. Set the benchmark for brand work in fintech — prove that category-defining campaigns come from strategic rigor and creative excellence working together. You’ll establish Pleo as the model for how brands should think about their audience, and show that understanding someone better than anyone else is a more powerful differentiator than any feature. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: 10+ years in brand marketing (B2B or fintech might be helpful, but we care more about the thinking than the category) A portfolio of work that shows you’ve led campaigns from strategy through to execution — ideally integrated campaigns that work across multiple channels Strong stakeholder management skills — you can influence a room, sell an idea, and push back when something isn’t working Strategic thinking + execution mindset — you’re equally comfortable building a 6-month brand strategy and getting your hands dirty on day-to-day campaign work Comfort with ambiguity and pace — this is a growing company, and things move fast. You thrive in that Understanding of how brand and pipeline connect — you know that brand campaigns need to serve business growth, not just awareness A point of view on category dynamics — you can look at a market and spot where everyone’s getting it wrong A strong understanding for when/how to localise concepts, messaging & GTM campaigns across different markets. Fluency in one or more of our European markets is a bonus (not required, but helpful) Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You want to reframe an entire category's conversation by competing on human insight rather than just feature parity. You thrive in a fast-paced, autonomous environment where you can build campaigns that serve as a 5-year foundation. You believe brand strategy must be grounded in audience understanding and directly drive business outcomes. This role is not a good fit for you if: You prefer purely high-level strategy without getting hands-on with day-to-day campaign execution. You operate best in rigid, highly structured environments with slow moving pace and minimal ambiguity. You view brand marketing in isolation from performance data, pipeline metrics, and commercial growth. How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll: Map customer journeys across SMB, mid-market, and enterprise segments to identify brand opportunities. Develop a comprehensive European brand roadmap that builds on recent launch momentum. Develop a comprehensive European brand roadmap that builds on recent launch momentum. The location Please note: We can hire on a hybrid set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work . We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations. Show me the benefits! Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards). For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role Final Interview : A final interview with a senior leader Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! Last time we hired for this role, we received a total vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include: CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background! Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here . Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

  • You believe brand strategy must be grounded in audience understanding and directly drive business outcomes.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer purely high-level strategy without getting hands-on with day-to-day campaign execution.

  • You operate best in rigid, highly structured environments with slow moving pace and minimal ambiguity.

  • You view brand marketing in isolation from performance data, pipeline metrics, and commercial growth.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

Reporting to our President of Product and Technology, you'll lead a 40+ person organisation, with a remit that spans our Travel, Spend, and Events products. You’ll lead a talented, collaborative and innovative team who are excellent at what they do.   • Modern stack fluency. Fluency across the modern data stack, such as dbt, Snowflake, conversational analytics and Looker or Tableau, plus the instinct to build your own tooling where it gives us an edge.

raw.jobDescription:
At Veriff's Biometric Solutions team, we are trying to prove, in real time, that the person on the other side of the screen is real and who they claim to be. Our ML-powered platform uses advanced image recognition, facial verification, face recognition, facial anti-spoofing (liveness detection), and behavior analysis to make identity decisions.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build and scale our real-time verification services, with security, scalability, and maintainability at the core.

You'll help us protect honest people online by:

  • Owning the design and evolution of the architecture for a strategically critical product area, making the calls that shape scalability, security, and maintainability for years
  • Leading transformational architecture work: real-time matching at scale, resilient event-driven services, and the CI/CD and observability foundations that make them dependable
  • Setting and raising engineering standards, and mentoring and growing the engineers around you
  • Partnering closely with other engineers, ML data scientists, and specialists to turn complex identity problems into working products, and driving cross-functional alignment with product and dependency teams
  • Building scalable, maintainable APIs and event-driven services that other teams and external customers depend on

You are the right future Veriffian if you have

  • Over 5 years of experience building and operating large-scale applications (ideally in Python)
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, modular design, and SOLID principles, with a track record of architectural ownership
  • Experience building scalable, maintainable APIs and working with message-queuing concepts
  • Fluency with CI/CD, monitoring, and what it takes to run reliable, high-throughput services in production
  • Comfort with a range of testing strategies for robust, reliable software
  • A working understanding of relational databases and structured logging systems
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, able to align engineers and non-engineers around a technical vision
  • A self-starter mindset that balances both tech and product decisions to come up with a balanced outcome for both customers and engineers.
  • A history of mentoring engineers and explaining your solutions to non-engineers

Nice to have:

  • Some experience working with mobile SDKs (iOS, Android) or Web in React
  • Previous experience working on a B2B/SaaS product

You can explore our tech stack on StackShare.

Why Veriff?

We are the preferred identity verification platform partner for the world’s most innovative growth-driven organizations helping conveniently verify and safeguard users anywhere in the world. We support the broadest number of identity documents from nearly every country and territory in the world - and this is continually increasing! With a diverse team in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world. We strive to be the benchmark for trust online, and we take pride in being a positive force.

When you join Team Veriff, we offer you the opportunity to have a real impact and advance your career, while looking after you along the way with a range of benefits designed with you in mind. Some of our favorites include...

  • Flexibility to work from home
  • Stock options that ensure your share in our success
  • Extra recharge days on top of your annual vacation
  • Comprehensive relocation support to Estonia or Spain
  • Extensive medical, dental, and vision insurance to ensure you’re feeling great physically and mentally
  • Learning and Development & Health and Sports budget that you are free to tailor to your own needs
  • Four weeks of fully paid sabbatical leave after reaching your 5th work anniversary

We are an Equal Opportunities employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Different opinions, perspectives and personalities push us forward. We want to hear from people who are passionate about their work and align with our values. Regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability. We also know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates - so rest assured, whoever you are, we want to hear from you!

raw.jobDescription:
We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

London or UK Remote | Senior Engineer (L50) £105,000 - £135,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | Technology - Engineering

About our Engineering Teams:

We have around 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.

These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.

We contribute to open source software as much as possible. Our blog is a good place to learn even more about what we do!

Your day-to-day

This role is all about collaborating with your team to make a difference to your customers. As a backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside other disciplines like product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more!

Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). They are: Core Banking, Business Banking, Wealth, Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Platform, Fincrime, Security & Expansion. All of our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront- from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.

They’re all looking for additional Backend Engineers right now, we do a standard interview process across all our collectives and at the end we will find the best match for you based on your skills, experience, preferences and aligning with the business need!

Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.

How we work

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays ️

Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency ✨

If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.

Work the way that works for you with Monzo!

You should apply if:

  • you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product
  • you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day
  • you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions
  • you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity
  • you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software
  • you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).
  • you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing

We're on the look out for L50 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our Engineering Progression Framework - we will interview you across the whole frame work, so if you are not sure what level you are aiming for please chat to your recruiters!

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything thats listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

What you’ll be working on:

We hire very technically agnostic so whilst we use the below technologies we do not expect prior knowledge, you will be fully supported in our organised onboarding to get up to speed in the below:

  • Go to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial here)
  • Cassandra for most persistent data storage
  • Kafka for our asynchronous message queue
  • Kubernetes and Docker to schedule and run our services
  • Envoy Proxy for RPC
  • AWS for most of our production infrastructure and GCP for most of our data infrastructure
  • React for our public web apps and internal tools
  • We also have physical datacenters with actual cables to connect to various third parties

The Interview Process:

Our interview process involves three main stages:

  1. Initial Call
  2. Take home task or pair coding exercise
  3. Final interview: including a system design and a behavioural interview

Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.

One of our engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see here.

What’s in it for you:

£105,000 - £135,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance

✈️We can help you relocate to the UK

✅We can sponsor visas.

This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here

We're usually always hiring for Backend Engineers, so there's no closing date for this job.

#LI-Remote

#LI-NB

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage

title: HR-Generalist (m/w/d) – Personaladministration, Recruiting & Digitalisierung
description: Du kannst Personalarbeit – und möchtest mehr als nur verwalten? Bei uns erwartet dich keine große HR-Abteilung mit vielen Spezialisten. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unseren operativen Personalbereich mit rund 85 Mitarbeitenden – eigenständig, nah an den Menschen und in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung und Teamleitern. Wir suchen jemanden, der Personaladministration zuverlässig organisiert, passende neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen gewinnt und unsere Prozesse Schritt für Schritt moderner macht. Aufgaben Personaladministration und Mitarbeiterbetreuung Den operativen Personalbereich weitgehend eigenverantwortlich betreuen. Arbeitsverträge, Vertragsänderungen, Bescheinigungen und weitere Personaldokumente vorbereiten und verwalten. Personaldaten und digitale Personalakten aktuell halten und administrative Fristen nachverfolgen. Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte bei alltäglichen Personalfragen unterstützen – verständlich, pragmatisch und auch bei unterschiedlichen Sprachkenntnissen klar in der Kommunikation. Arbeitsrechtliche Fragestellungen beurteilen sowie personelle Maßnahmen und Unterlagen eigenständig vorbereiten und mit der Geschäftsführung abstimmen. Mit Buchhaltung und Teamleitern zusammenarbeiten; die operative Abwesenheitsverwaltung bleibt bei den Teamleitern. Recruiting – regional und mit Blick auf nachhaltige Einstellungen Geeignete Mitarbeitende insbesondere für gewerbliche und operative Tätigkeiten am Standort Heiligenhaus und in der Umgebung gewinnen. Recruiting über JOIN, Indeed, StepStone und unser Programm „Mitarbeiter werben Mitarbeiter“ organisieren und optimieren. Bewerbungen sichten, Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten vorqualifizieren und Vorstellungsgespräche gemeinsam mit den Teamleitern führen. Nicht nur schnell offene Stellen besetzen, sondern sorgfältig auswählen, damit Menschen fachlich und persönlich langfristig zu uns passen. Mit der Geschäftsführung und den Führungskräften Anforderungen und Auswahlkriterien weiterentwickeln. Digitalisierung und KI Bestehende Abläufe kritisch hinterfragen und die begonnene Professionalisierung unserer Personalarbeit fortsetzen. Unsere webbasierte Personalverwaltung nutzen und Verbesserungen anstoßen; ältere Systeme und Medienbrüche pragmatisch berücksichtigen. Digitale Workflows und sinnvolle Automatisierung für Administration und Recruiting mitentwickeln. Offen mit KI-gestützten Hilfsmitteln experimentieren, beispielsweise bei der strukturierten Aufbereitung von Bewerbungen – mit Datenschutz, nachvollziehbaren Kriterien und menschlicher Entscheidung über Bewerbende. Das bringst du mit Eine kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise mit Personalbezug, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Praktische Erfahrung in operativer Personalarbeit und Recruiting; zwei bis drei Jahre können ausreichen, wenn du bereits eigenständig Verantwortung getragen hast. Fundierte Kenntnisse des Arbeitsrechts und Sicherheit bei der Vorbereitung und Einschätzung arbeitsrechtlicher Vorgänge. Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Personalstrukturen mittlerer Größe und/oder gewerblichen Mitarbeitenden. Gute Menschenkenntnis, sorgfältige Bewerberauswahl und klare, verständliche Kommunikation. Selbstständigkeit, Organisationstalent, Diskretion und die Fähigkeit, auch im turbulenten Alltag den Überblick zu behalten. Interesse an digitalen Werkzeugen, Prozessverbesserung und KI. Du musst noch keinen kompletten Personalbereich allein geleitet haben. Wichtiger ist, dass du schon Verantwortung übernommen hast und bereit bist, den Bereich bei uns eigenständig zu führen. Das bieten wir dir Unbefristete Festanstellung mit sechs Monaten Probezeit. 30 bis 40 Wochenstunden; Vollzeit ist willkommen. Arbeit überwiegend in Heiligenhaus; nach der Einarbeitung Homeoffice nach Absprache möglich. Eigenständige Verantwortung für deinen Bereich und unmittelbare Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und unseren Teamleitern. Kurze Wege, unkomplizierte Kommunikation und die Möglichkeit, bestehende Abläufe aktiv zu verbessern. Raum für zeitgemäße Personalarbeit, digitale Prozesse, Automatisierung und KI. Eine langfristige Perspektive in einem Unternehmen, das sich verändern möchte. Wir suchen keine Person, die bloß Personalvorgänge abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der das Tagesgeschäft im Griff hat und mit uns bessere Lösungen entwickelt. Interessiert? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung über JOIN. Erzähl uns gerne, was du bisher verantwortlich übernommen hast und welche Ideen du für moderne, pragmatische Personalarbeit mitbringst. Übrigens, passend zu unserer Unternehmenskultur sind wir direkt ins „Du“ geswitcht. Also darfst auch du gerne alle Ansprechpartner*innen bei uns im Unternehmen duzen. It's up to you : ) Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description:
Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen.

We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market. 

 

Location: London - Soho Office / Hybrid (2 days per week in the office Weds & Thurs)
Reporting to: Head of Engineering

The Role  

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead one or more of our cross-functional product development teams at Rightmove. You’ll be responsible for building a healthy, high-performing team by enabling others to do their best work, maintaining strong delivery focus, and fostering a culture that reflects our values. 

Engineering Managers at Rightmove are not just people leaders, but delivery enablers, engineering advocates, and strategic partners to Product Managers. You’ll work collaboratively to ensure teams are focusing on the right things, solving valuable problems, and operating in a sustainable, inclusive way. You’ll have a big impact on the shape of our engineering organisation, playing a key role in how we plan, deliver, grow talent, and scale systems across the business. 

For a glimpse into the technical make-up of the UKs favourite property portal works, head to our tech blog. 

What you'll be doing  

People and Team Development 

  • Support the growth of engineers through clear development goals, coaching, feedback, and mentoring. 
  • Create a psychologically safe and inclusive environment where people are empowered to do great work and challenge with care. 
  • Align career development with team success, ensuring that individuals are stretched and supported in the right ways. 
  • Champion our culture, modelling high standards and helping others connect, grow, and thrive. 

Planning and Delivery 

  • Partner with your Product Manager to align priorities, capacity, and scope - creating clear goals and realistic plans. 
  • Ensure your team has the right structure, skills, and clarity to deliver consistently and sustainably. 
  • Monitor delivery flow, remove blockers, and drive improvements to how the team works (including process, quality, and velocity). 
  • Proactively manage risks, make trade-offs where needed, and represent your team in cross-functional planning. 

Technical Stewardship 

  • Ensure the long-term health and maintainability of the systems your team owns. 
  • Collaborate with tech leads, architects, and other EMs to share context, resolve dependencies, and improve system design. 
  • Encourage good practices around testing, observability, performance, and resilience - ensuring your team owns their systems in production. 

Hiring and Talent Development 

  • Take a leading role in hiring, onboarding, and growing diverse engineering talent. 
  • Shape team structure and capabilities over time, based on what the work needs and where people can grow. 
  • Support calibration and promotion processes by advocating fairly and clearly for your engineers. 

Collaboration and Leadership 

  • Build a strong partnership with your PM, acting as a united leadership pair who bring clarity and momentum to the team. 
  • Translate between technical and business contexts, ensuring stakeholders are informed and aligned. 
  • Operate with a broader view - solving local problems, but always in service of organisation-wide outcomes. 

What we're looking for 

  • Prior experience managing software engineers in a product development environment. 
  • A strong track record of supporting delivery and improving team ways of working. 
  • Confidence in navigating planning, estimation, scope, and stakeholder alignment. 
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to build trust across a wide range of people and roles. 
  • A calm, thoughtful, and pragmatic approach - especially when the stakes are high or ambiguity is present. 
  • A genuine interest in growing others, including coaching, feedback, and performance development. 

If you’re passionate about creating the conditions for great engineering and excited about building impactful teams that solve real problems, we’d love to hear from you. 

Our approach to AI 
At Rightmove, we believe software and product are ultimately people problems, and everything we build aims to improve the lives of others. We see AI as a helpful way to create more space for the human side of our work, from understanding real needs to making sure we are solving the right problems in the right way. There is an expectation that you are proactive in exploring how AI can support your own workflow and productivity, and that you approach it with curiosity and an open mind. 

Life at Rightmove

Despite our growth, we’ve remained a friendly, supportive place to work, with employee #1 still working here!  We’ve done this by placing the Rightmove Hows at the heart of everything we do. These are the essential values that reflect our culture, and include:

  • We create value…by delivering results and building trust with partners and consumers.
  • We think bigger…by acting with curiosity and setting bold aspirations.
  • We care deeply…by being real, having fun, and valuing diversity.
  • We move together…by being one team - internally collaborative, externally competitive.
  • We make a difference…by focusing on delivering measurable impact.

 

 

We believe in careers that open doors and help our team develop by providing an open and inclusive work environment, offering ongoing   training opportunities, and supporting charity fundraising events. And with 89% of Rightmovers saying we’re a great place to work, we’re clearly doing something right! 


What we offer

  • Cash plan for dental, optical and physio treatments.
  • Private Medical Insurance, Pension and Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Plan.
  • 27 days holiday plus two (paid) volunteering days a year to give back, and holiday buy schemes.
  • Contributory stakeholder pension.
  • Life assurance at 4x your basic salary to a spouse, family member or other nominated person in your life.
  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Paid leave for maternity, paternity, adoption & fertility.
  • Travel Loans, Bike to Work scheme, Rental Deposit Loan.
  • Charitable contributions through Payroll Giving and donation matching.
  • Access deals and discounts on things like travel, electronics, fashion, gym memberships, cinema discounts and more.
  • We offer hybrid working with a minimum of 2 days in the office. For our roles, such as Field or Home-based positions, different working arrangements apply - full details will be shared during the recruitment process.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Rightmove will never discriminate based on age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender reassignment, marriage / civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity or sexual orientation. 

At Rightmove, we believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce leads to better innovation, productivity, and overall success. We are committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of their background or identity, to develop and promote a diverse culture that reflects the communities we serve.

title: Associate Editorial Director- 2 Year FTC
description:
This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK. This is a 2 Year FTC.

Role Summary

In this role you will oversee a subset of the growing PLOS journals portfolio: you will manage PLOS Biology and PLOS Medicine, with line-management of their professional Editors-in-Chief, and provide editorial oversight for a diverse set of journals led by academic volunteers across a range of disciplines in biology, human and environmental health. You will manage in line with PLOS strategy, helping to keep PLOS at the forefront of open science publishing and trusted content. You will leverage your strong relationships with the scientific community to drive engagement and develop the journals to meet the evolving needs of their global communities. You will work collaboratively with the journals’ Editorial Boards, and in-house colleagues, to create and deliver against journal strategies, using your international networks to grow PLOS’ profile and reputation.

The role is an integral part of the senior PLOS editorial leadership. As such, you will be expected to engage PLOS Leaders’ Framework—adaptive decision-making, empowering others, iterative learning, agility, resilience, systems thinking, continuous improvement, catalysing opportunity—at an advanced level. As part of that leadership, you will also own ad hoc projects across the entire PLOS journals portfolio. Priority projects currently relate to quality control, workflow optimization, cost efficiency, non-article research outputs (data and code), policy development and community engagement. You will embrace change, and lead your teams effectively through it.

 

Responsibilities

Journal portfolio management

  • Work closely with the Directors of Editorial, Publishing, MarComms and Global Development to develop an editorial strategy for a portfolio of PLOS journals that supports PLOS’s commitments to Open Science, DEI, community engagement, trusted content and customer service
  • Identify and develop opportunities to expand the portfolio in line with PLOS strategy
  • Develop and oversee attainment of multi-term performance metrics for individual journals
  • Partner with the Publishing Director to develop and manage annual budgets, ensuring responsible decision-making and efficient resource allocation to meet both budget and quality standards
  • Work closely with Operations colleagues and vendors to oversee optimization of editorial workflows, systems and reporting
  • Work closely with Marketing and Communications colleagues to ensure promotion of journal content and PLOS’ mission, and to drive journal submissions and uptake of Open Science practices
  • Ensure that Editorial makes effective and efficient use of cross-journal Centers of Excellence (e.g. Publication Ethics, Editorial Board Services)
  • Ensure that the portfolio shares cohesive and consistent editorial policies and quality standards, reacting dynamically to changing community needs while forefronting Open Science
  • Lead cross-journal initiatives, overseeing development of systems and workflows
  • Oversee Editorial participation in community initiatives, conferences and events, ensuring equality of opportunity and alignment with PLOS’ mission
  • Help to ensure best-practice document hygiene and information sharing by everyone in Editorial

People management

  • Lead a high-performing and cohesive team of Editorial staff (up to 4 direct reports), fostering a cross-portfolio and cross-cultural mindset
  • Ensure strategy is collaboratively translated into clear tactics for teams and individual staff, and monitor progress against goals regularly
  • Lead by example, modeling open and clear communication and ensuring all stakeholders understand their roles and responsibilities
  • Build strong relationships with Editorial Boards within a true partnership framework
  • Address underperformance swiftly, sensitively and supportively, in collaboration with Line Manager and People & Culture team
  • Act as a thought-partner to, and deputize for, the Editorial Director

Diversity, equity and inclusion
