title: Associate Director, Customer Compensation & Policy
description:
About the Role 

Within Global Customer Experience (GCX), our mission is to advance the HelloFresh customer relationship from reactive resolution to proactive, trust-building service. The compensation function sits at the heart of that mission: it is the mechanism through which the business acknowledges failures, restores customer confidence, and, when done well, turns a bad experience into a reason to stay.

The Associate Director, Customer Compensation & Policy is responsible for the global strategy, architecture, and governance of how HelloFresh compensates customers across all markets and brands. This is not a policy maintenance role. It is a strategic function that sits at the intersection of customer economics, operational data, behavioral experimentation, and cross-functional influence.

You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You will shape a multi-year roadmap and hold peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market Leadership accountable for the quality of inputs that determine how well and how efficiently we recover customer trust.

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination: analytical rigor sharp enough to architect a global compensation engine from first principles, and the executive presence to drive adoption across a complex, multi-market organization without formal authority over most of the people they need to move.

What You'll Own 

 Global Compensation Strategy & Engine Architecture

  • Own the end-to-end strategic vision for how HelloFresh categorizes customer errors and determines compensation across all markets, brands, and contact channels.
  • Lead the design and continuous evolution of the compensation engine: along with Tech, you’ll define the the rules, thresholds, segmentation logic, and automation frameworks that govern recovery decisions at scale.
  • Define the principles that govern trade-offs between customer generosity and cost discipline and translate those principles into operational rules that hold across market complexity and brand variation.
  • Partner with Technology to ensure the compensation engine is scalable, auditable, and capable of supporting dynamic, AI-assisted decisioning as the product evolves.

Experimentation & Behavioral Economics

  • Set the global roadmap for compensation experimentation: A/B testing across offer types, value levels, channel timing, and segmentation variables.
  • Apply behavioral economics frameworks to compensation design understanding how recovery offers shape long-term retention, repurchase behavior, and brand perception, not just immediate satisfaction.
  • Define the measurement framework for experimentation: what constitutes a successful test, what confidence warrants global rollout, and how results are synthesized into durable policy change.
  • Partner with Analytics & Insights to ensure test design, sample integrity, and rollout analysis meet a rigorous standard of evidence.

Financial Stewardship & Cost Governance

  • Own the global compensation P&L line: tracking spend by market, error category, customer segment, and channel — and holding yourself accountable to defined cost-per-incident and avoidable-contact targets.
  • Identify and close financial leakage: cases where compensation is being issued without policy justification, at incorrect values, or at the wrong frequency.
  • Build the reporting infrastructure that makes compensation economics visible to GCX leadership, market GMs, and Finance — with the granularity and context needed to drive decisions.
  • Define the right balance between cost optimization and customer lifetime value investment: not just 'spend less' but 'spend where it earns back.

Fraud Policy & Global Governance

  • Own the global fraud and abuse prevention framework: the policies, detection logic, thresholds, and escalation paths that protect the business without creating friction for genuine customers.
  • Lead the governance rhythm for policy: quarterly reviews, market exception management, escalation adjudication, and framework versioning across a multi-brand, multi-market environment.
  • Act as the final authority on complex, cross-market policy gaps — resolving ambiguity with speed, consistency, and strategic clarity rather than routing decisions upward by default.
  • Maintain global standards while creating principled space for market-level adaptation where local context genuinely requires it.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Accountability

  • Represent the compensation function in senior forums translating customer economics into requirements that peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market GMs must respond to.
  • Hold cross-functional partners accountable for the upstream data quality, operational accuracy, and system reliability that the compensation engine depends on.
  • Drive adoption of policy changes across markets and brands, building communication and change management plans that make new frameworks land — not just launch.
  • Influence at VP and Director level across multiple functions; escalate only strategic blockers, not routine alignment.

What You'll Bring 

Education

  • MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification required.
  • Undergraduate degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline.

Experience

  • 8–12 years of progressive experience in customer strategy, pricing, operations, or a directly adjacent domain with meaningful exposure to global, multi-market environments.
  • Demonstrated track record of owning a financially significant operational lever and managing it with both analytical precision and strategic judgment.
  • Prior experience leading and developing teams; comfort operating as a senior individual contributor and a people leader simultaneously.
  • Background in subscription commerce, logistics, or consumer-facing operations strongly preferred. Familiarity with the economics of customer recovery in high-volume, low-margin environments is a distinct advantage.

Technical & Analytical

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and data analysis; able to build and pressure-test the analytical models that underpin policy decisions without delegating the logic to others.
  • Fluency with experimentation methodology: test design, statistical significance, holdout analysis, and the translation of results into policy not just reporting.
  • Experience working with or alongside engineering teams to define product and system requirements for rules-based or AI-assisted decisioning tools.
  • Comfort with financial modeling: building the business case for compensation investment, forecasting spend impact, and tracking actuals against plan.

Leadership & Influence

  • Senior executive presence: able to walk into a GM, COO, or CFO conversation with a clear point of view, defend it under pressure, and leave with alignment.
  • A credible voice with peers and upward stakeholders not because of title, but because of the quality of analysis and clarity of communication.
  • Structured and decisive under ambiguity: able to make a defensible call with incomplete information and adjust as evidence develops.
  • Genuinely collaborative across markets and functions able to hold people to standards without damaging the relationships needed to sustain them.

title: Tactical Data Link Expert (All Genders)
description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

About the Team

Minerva is STARK's command and control software — the brain that connects operators to autonomous systems across multiple domains in real time. The Minerva team is a small, senior software group based in Berlin and Munich, working directly with our systems and hardware teams to build mission-critical C2 capabilities deployed in active operational environments.
We move fast, ship real software, and operate under constraints most engineers never encounter — low-bandwidth networks, air-gapped devices, high-stakes decision loops. There is no room for abstraction for its own sake. Everything we build ends up in the hands of real operators in the field.

Your Mission

Support the development, integration, testing, and operational use of tactical data link capabilities for STARK’s unmanned systems, Ground Control Stations, and wider command-and-control environments. You will help ensure that our systems can communicate reliably and securely with military networks, command posts, allied platforms, and mission systems. A key part of the role is to evaluate, understand, and integrate tactical communication standards and technologies such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, and other military data link solutions. You will translate operational communication requirements into practical integration concepts, test setups, and deployable system configurations.

Responsibilities

 

  • Tactical Data Link Integration: Support the integration of tactical data link capabilities such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, and other military communication systems into STARK platforms and Ground Control Station environments.
  • Interoperability Concepts: Define and support communication concepts that enable reliable data exchange between unmanned systems, GCS setups, command centers, allied platforms, and external mission systems.
  • Requirements Translation: Translate operational and military communication requirements into technical integration requirements, interface definitions, test needs, and subsystem-level implementation concepts.
  • System Interface Support: Work with engineering, software, network, RF, modem, antenna, and GCS teams to align interfaces, protocols, data flows, configuration requirements, and integration constraints.
  • SATCOM & Beyond-Line-of-Sight Support: Support concepts and integration activities for SATCOM, long-range communication paths, and other beyond-line-of-sight connectivity options.
  • Testing & Validation: Plan and support lab tests, field tests, interoperability checks, and validation activities for tactical data link and communication setups.
  • Security & Reliability: Contribute to secure, robust, and mission-ready communication architectures, considering availability, latency, data integrity, authentication, and operational constraints.
  • Supplier & Partner Coordination: Work with external suppliers, partners, military stakeholders, and internal teams to assess data link options, integration dependencies, and technical feasibility.

title: Executive Recruiting Director – EMEA
description:
At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honoring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.
 
AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (AlixPartners office) and remote working.

What you’ll do

The PMD Recruiting Director - EMEA is a new, highly visible, and critical role on AlixPartners’ Executive Recruiting team. Reporting to the Global Head, Executive Recruiting, you will lead the executive recruiting team and function in EMEA, covering the UK, DACH, Italy, France, and the Middle East, focused on Partner (non-equity) and Partner & Managing Director (equity) candidates. You will set the strategy for this dynamic function, create trust-based executive stakeholder relationships, implement best practices, mentor and develop the team, and personally manage multiple searches and candidate relationships.

An important focus of this role is building trusted relationships with the highly matrixed EMEA leadership team, including regional and country leaders, and heads of Practices, Industries, and Service Lines. In addition, this role will often work with global leaders in the Americas and APAC. Strong communication skills, coupled with first-hand knowledge of local or country employment laws and customs, are very important.

This role will be a culture carrier for the team and function, reinforcing a forward-looking, inclusive, collaborative, and creative work environment. You will create strong connections with candidates, helping guide them through a rigorous process with care and excellent communication. We do not “sell” candidates on joining AlixPartners; we guide them and our colleagues on making the best decision for everyone.

This role is part of a close-knit global team that works across EMEA, APAC and the Americas, and has an opportunity to work across and provide guidance to all regions. At its core, this role will work closely with the global executive recruitment team, candidates, and stakeholders to ensure all parties experience a caring, inclusive, efficient, and high-quality recruitment process. You will also oversee elements of the executive onboarding experience, in partnership with the People, Office, and IT teams. The role is vital to making sure everyone has the information they need, when they need it, while providing a seamless, thoughtful experience for all parties. In addition, you will play a meaningful role in ensuring our systems and processes work effectively and efficiently - and are compliant with firm policies and local laws and customs.

AlixPartners is committed to our people’s growth, development, and career progression. This role will be a key part of facilitating our forward-facing and collaborative culture. It is located in London, Munich, Dusseldorf, or Berlin. Paid relocation is not available. Occasional travel may be expected.

 Additionally, you will:

  • Oversee and perpetually improve the candidate experience, from their first introduction to AlixPartners to their onboarding process.
  • Mentor and develop the EMEA recruiting team, including recruiters, researchers, and coordinators, maintain an engaging, developmental, forward-looking, and fun work environment.
  • Partner with the Global Head of Executive recruiting on performance, budget, workflow, external search firm partnerships, and special projects.
  • Own key searches end-to-end, including research, candidate outreach, interview process (prep emails, debriefs, stakeholder alignment, etc.), evaluations, and candidate write-ups.
  • Facilitate the development of and write the long-form, detailed business cases for final-stage PMD candidates, which are evaluated by the CEOs and Board of Directors. This process involves complex candidate and senior stakeholder alignment and management and requires a knowledge of the key drivers for a consulting organization.
  • Vet and review / finalize contracts and relationships with contingent and retained external search firms, with a keen eye to the firm’s reputation, candidate’s experience, and relevant budgets.
  • Ensure recruiting data is collected, recorded, and documented in a timely, confidential, and legally compliant manner.
  • Be a “super user” of our current CRM tool, currently Greenhouse, finding ways to optimize the application to enhance the candidate experience, data management, scheduling, and reporting.
  • Additional responsibilities as identified. This description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties, or responsibilities.

What you’ll need

  • Problem solving – able to anticipate opportunities and obstacles - and react / plan accordingly in a calm and engaging manner that maintains a motivated team and engages leaders.
  • A player / coach orientation, with experience leading geographically dispersed teams and colleagues through multiple, sometimes competing priorities and projects, taking on work as needed to meet goals and objectives.
  • A formidable knowledge of the consulting and related candidate pool landscape, including exec consulting firms or all sizes working across Restructuring, Advisory and Risk.
  • Strong understanding of the core business drivers and executive considerations within a consulting or similar professional services organization, including utilization, client management, commercials, cultural alignment, etc.
  • A strong orientation to develop and motivate a team; creative, consultative, constructive, collegial, and skilled at providing feedback and praise.
  • An eye to detail, especially in written communications, reports, and presentations.
  • Experience leading an executive search team / function in EMEA within a consulting or professional services organization, with depth in research, and candidate outreach and cultivation, offer negotiations, and onboarding.
  • Experience working in an executive search firm is strongly preferred.
  • A passion for prose - a proven ability to write concise, action oriented, clear executive communications, reports, and executive / Board-ready documents.
  • A strong sense of ownership - holds oneself personally accountable for the team’s success and opportunities for improvement.
  • Excellent client-service orientation - able to influence, present to, and successfully collaborate with a range of executive stakeholders across a complex matrix. You understand their motivations and goals, and operate as their executive search subject matter expert.
  • Excellent organization and time management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and adapt to changing circumstances.
  • Ability to work independently to drive multiple, shifting priorities with a strong sense of urgency.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Fluency in German, French and/or Italian considered a plus.
  • A sense of humor and humility.
  • Proficiency in MS PowerPoint, Teams, Word, and Excel.
  • Ability to travel, as required.
  • Ability to work full time in an office and remote environment; physically able to sit/stand at a computer and work in front of a computer screen for significant portions of the workday.
  • Willingness to work outside of normal business hours, as needed and in particular as unique projects/needs arise.
  • Must become familiar with, and promote and abide by, our Core Values as defined by the AlixPartners’ Code of Conduct and foster an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organization.

The firm offers market-leading benefits that provide flexible options to support our employee’s needs including health benefits to help prioritise their physical and emotional well-being, time-off policies to help to recharge and financial/ retirement benefits that offer income protection and support long-term planning.

The benefit type and level differ per location.

AlixPartners is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, status as a protected veteran, or disability.

Reporting to the Director, Field Engineering (Specialist).

The impact you will have:

  • Provide technical leadership to guide strategic customers to successful implementations on big data projects, ranging from architectural and security design to development and deployment best practices including automation
  • Architect production-level workloads, including end-to-end pipeline load performance testing and optimisation
  • Provide technical expertise in cloud infrastructure and security relating to our  Databricks Lakehouse Platform   
  • Assist Solution Architects with more advanced aspects of the technical sale including custom proof of concept content, workload sizing, and custom architectures
  • Improve community adoption (through tutorials, training, hackathons, conference presentations)
  • Contribute to the Databricks Community and act as a technical SME.

What we look for:

  • Pre-sales or post-sales experience working with external clients across a variety of industry markets
  • Experience as a Data Platform engineer designing, setting up, and maintaining production-grade big data systems (Spark)
  • Experience designing cloud infrastructure and services, in particular in AWS and Azure, applying best practices in cloud security and networking, including: 
    • Designing, deploying, and maintaining cloud networks and connectivity (VPC/VNet design, routing, segmentation, private connectivity).
    • Architect production cloud networks for data and AI workloads, including segmentation and routing, data exfiltration prevention, and performance/reliability
    • Identity & Access Management (e.g. role-based access control, using the principle of least privilege, integration with IdPs, etc)

description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

The Risk Controlling team shapes Raisin Group’s resilience by establishing and maintaining the group-wide risk management framework in line with regulatory standards such as Basel. The team defines risk policies and controls and is responsible for identifying and assessing material risks across the group, including operational, credit, market, and liquidity risk, using methods such as risk assessments, stress testing, and scenario analysis.

In addition, Risk Controlling continuously monitors the group’s risk profile through risk metrics, key risk indicators, and early warning signals. The team prepares risk reporting for senior management and regulatory authorities and supports capital and liquidity adequacy assessments in line with regulatory requirements, ensuring the business model is backed by appropriate risk-bearing capacity and liquidity strength.

Your Responsibilities

The Operational Risk Manager identifies, assesses, monitors, and reports operational risks in line with internal frameworks and regulatory requirements, including MaRisk and Basel III, as part of the second line of defense.

Key responsibilities:

  • Perform operational risk identification and assessment, including RCSA, scenario analysis, and loss database management
  • Proactively follow up on operational risk events and conduct lessons-learned analyses with business units
  • Provide independent operational risk input to projects and New Product Approval Processes
  • Monitor risk indicators and oversee incident and loss reporting
  • Maintain and enhance the Operational Risk Management Framework in line with MaRisk and Basel III
  • Prepare operational risk reports for senior management and governance committees
  • Support development of risk appetite and control enhancements

Your Profile

You bring strong analytical capability, sound judgment, and a structured approach to operational risk management in a regulated banking environment.

Key requirements:

  • Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Risk Management, Economics, or a related field
  • 3–5 years of experience in operational risk management, internal audit, or risk consulting within banking or financial services
  • Hands-on experience with RCSA, incident management, and risk indicators
  • Solid knowledge of regulatory requirements, including MaRisk and Basel III
  • Experience with risk management systems and tools, including loss database and RCSA tracking
  • Ability to balance operational execution with an enterprise-wide risk perspective
  • Strong communication skills to work across functions and present risk topics to senior management
  • Proactive, independent working style with strong ownership and attention to detail
  • Professional certifications are a plus

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

We’re hiring a GTM Systems Lead to own the technology behind Granola’s commercial team as we scale.

You’ll design, build and run the systems our Sales and CS teams rely on. Our current stack has served us well, but it needs to evolve as the team grows. You’ll take responsibility for how the tools fit together, what we build versus buy, and how information flows between them.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll set the direction of the stack and implement the technical changes that make it work. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Data, and report to the Head of RevOps. You won’t be limited to administering a CRM or building isolated automations: you’ll own how the whole system works.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and evolve the GTM stack. Decide how our Sales and CS systems should fit together, what to build versus buy, and what to prioritise as we grow.

  • Own the technical architecture of our CRM, Attio. Shape its data model, objects, workflows and integrations. You’ll be hands-on with configuration, particularly early on, but routine admin won’t be the sole focus of the role.

  • Build and maintain integrations. Make data flow reliably across Attio and our wider toolset, including Apollo, Cal.com, Tally and Polytomic, and into the data systems used by the wider business.

  • Own the wider toolset. Assess new tools and vendors, improve or replace what isn’t working, and make sure the stack is useful, reliable and cost-conscious.

  • Find opportunities for automation and AI. Identify work that could be made easier for Sales and CS, and build or collaborate on solutions where they fit the priorities of the stack.

  • Keep systems dependable. Troubleshoot problems, establish sensible governance and documentation, and partner with IT on access and security.

  • Understand how teams work. Get close to Sales and CS workflows so the systems you build solve real problems, not just technical ones.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience designing, building and owning systems used by a growing commercial team. Relevant hands-on experience matters more to us than a particular number of years or experience with a specific CRM.

  • Sound judgement about system architecture, priorities and build-versus-buy decisions—and the ability to explain those decisions to non-technical colleagues.

  • Technical depth beyond administering tools: you’ve built integrations and are comfortable working with APIs, webhooks and code. Experience with SQL, Python or JavaScript would be useful.

  • An understanding of CRM data models, routing, enrichment and the operational work needed to keep data flowing reliably.

  • A willingness to get into the weeds. You’re comfortable doing the implementation yourself while also thinking about how the stack should develop over time.

  • Curiosity about AI-powered GTM workflows, with experience building them a plus rather than a prerequisite.

  • A collaborative, low-ego approach. You can work through messy requests with Sales, CS and Data, challenge assumptions constructively, and ship solutions people can use.

  • You don’t need to have used Attio or every tool in our stack. We’re more interested in what you’ve built, how you think about systems, and how you’d apply that experience here.

We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart's demo in 1968 and we want to assemble the best crew to build this future together. Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable, and equity.

You'll be selling a product, not a service, into CISOs, security engineers and AppSec leads who are used to being pitched by categories they already understand. Your job is to earn a conversation with almost no brand recognition behind you, then run a genuinely consultative sale that gets underneath what a prospect is actually trying to achieve, not just what they say they want. You'll take on enterprise and partner-adjacent opportunities, competitive procurement, and buying groups that span security, engineering and the economic buyer. You'll also set the bar for the wider sales team: shaping how SDR intake and Customer Success handoff work, and helping newer Account Executives find their feet. What you'll do Own full-cycle new-logo opportunities from first qualified meeting through discovery, technical evaluation and signature, sourced by SDR, Marketing, partners and your own prospecting. Self-source a meaningful share of your own pipeline; build an account plan from a cold list rather than relying on inbound or SDR support. Run multi-threaded discovery across security, engineering and economic buyers, uncovering pain that a single conversation would miss. Own commercial negotiation, procurement and security review through to signature, including competitive processes, without needing support from the CRO. Maintain an accurate weekly forecast, with commit-to-close accuracy within 10%, sustained over multiple quarters. Shape SDR intake criteria and the Customer Success handoff standard; informally mentor newer Account Executives on deal strategy and technical positioning. Hand off cleanly to Customer Success at close, with deal-stage commitments documented in the CRM. What you'll bring 5–7+ years' full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally selling a technical product, not a service, into security or engineering buyers. A demonstrable track record of carrying and hitting quota of £750k–£1m+, at or above 100% in at least two of the last three years. Genuine consultative selling skill: comfortable asking why before pitching how, and building a business case from first principles rather than a script. Confidence selling into accounts where Cytix has little or no existing brand presence, building credibility through the conversation itself rather than a logo slide. A track record of pushing through setbacks and coming back stronger, and of actively seeking out the harder, less familiar deals rather than waiting to be asked. Genuinely bright and inquisitive: you ask sharp questions, pick things up fast, and enjoy getting to the bottom of a problem, whether that's a prospect's business or how Cytix's product works under the hood. Drawn to a business where new challenges show up daily; you take ownership of them and lean in, rather than waiting for someone else to sort it out. Comfortable taking yourself out of your comfort zone: new deal types, new buyer personas, situations you haven't fully rehearsed. What you'll get Time off that works for you: Unlimited holiday policy, including a guaranteed 33 days plus your birthday off Flexible hybrid working: Work in a way that helps you do your best work, while staying connected with the team. A stake in what we’re building: Eligible employees can participate in our EMI share option scheme. Healthcare that goes further: After one year’s service, access private healthcare through Vitality, including dental, optical, hearing and therapy cover. More ways to get around: Access our company car salary-sacrifice scheme. Support for growing families: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave. About Cytix Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on. That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words. We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you. Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still. Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale. See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it. Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics. Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on. title: System Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Wir bauen IT-Infrastruktur, die bei unseren Kunden einfach läuft, statt Umgebungen, die bei jedem Update zittern. Dazu gehören Server und Netzwerke vor Ort, unsere eigene Cloud in deutschen Rechenzentren, Microsoft 365 und immer öfter KI-Server, auf denen Sprachmodelle lokal laufen. Kein Ticket-Fließband, keine endlosen Abstimmungsrunden. Saubere Konzepte, schnelle Umsetzung, und am Ende läuft das Ding auch wirklich. Ob du schon Senior bist oder gerade richtig Fahrt aufnimmst, ist uns ehrlich gesagt zweitrangig. Bei uns zählt, was du baust und wie du an Probleme rangehst. Du bekommst echte Verantwortung, einen kurzen Draht zur Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, dich so schnell weiterzuentwickeln, wie du selbst Gas gibst. Aufgaben Du planst, baust und betreibst Server- und Netzwerkumgebungen bei unseren Kunden und in unserer eigenen Cloud Du betreibst unsere Cloud-Plattformen in deutschen Rechenzentren, von der Bereitstellung über Backup bis zum Monitoring Du kümmerst dich um Firewalls, VPN und Netzwerk, damit alles sicher und sauber miteinander spricht Du migrierst Kunden nach Microsoft 365 und richtest die Umgebungen so ein, dass sie auch in zwei Jahren noch sauber sind Du betreust unsere Kundenumgebungen zentral, von Patching und Monitoring bis Endpoint-Security und Backup Du baust Server und Workstations zusammen, prüfst sie auf Herz und Nieren und lieferst sie beim Kunden aus Du bist Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden, wenn etwas hakt, vom kurzen Anruf bis zur kniffligen Störung, und dokumentierst Lösungen so, dass auch der nächste durchblickt Du redest bei Standards, Tooling und unseren Abläufen aktiv mit und automatisierst, was sich wiederholt Du sprichst direkt mit Kunden, wenn es um Anforderungen, Konzepte und Lösungen geht Wir wollen wachsen und unsere Infrastruktur-Standards mit uns. title: Strategy Director
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

1255 - Strategy Director - GCS

Role Summary and Impact

This is an unparalleled opportunity to accelerate your career, empowering Colgate brand teams to lead, fostering robust collaboration with our hubs and growth markets, and spearheading true innovation in communications planning. You will be instrumental in leading the end-to-end BEP/IMC development process, overseeing the timely delivery of planning templates, content needs, and activation guidelines across EMEA.

Job Summary: As a Strategy Director, you will serve as a strategic planning leader, responsible for implementing the development of audience and communications strategies within Colgate’s BEP/IMC framework for EMEA. You will translate detailed consumer insight work, market trends, and client business objectives into actionable, integrated comms and audience plans that leverage the full breadth of WPP Media's capabilities and the wider WPP network expertise (creative, production, specialists). This role demands confident client collaborative leadership, analytical prowess, presentation skills, and a relentless passion for pushing the boundaries of media effectiveness and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership & BEP/IMC Development:

  • Drive the end-to-end development of comprehensive audience and communications strategies for Gold and Silver IMC projects and multi-market brands, ensuring alignment with overall brand objectives, business goals, and our established BEP/IMC development framework.
  • Be a key player in our strategic evolution, actively contributing to the 'Leading' and 'Collaborative' shifts outlined in our 2025 vision, acting as a primary strategic partner to clients and internal teams across WPP.
  • Contribute significantly to the strategic direction of BEP for the EMEA region, guiding its implementation and internal training initiatives.

Audience Expertise & Insight Generation:

  • Leverage your deep understanding of consumer behaviour and WPP's resources to drive profound audience understanding through proprietary tools, market research, behavioural data, and cultural insights. Identify key segments, motivations, and journey touchpoints, maintaining and evolving Colgate Audience Catalogue for the Division.
  • Identify sources of growth and translate them into locally relevant audience strategies, advising our Hubs on effective audience activation and enrichment.
  • Oversee the development of critical WPP comms-specific insight work for EMEA, sharing best practices across the network.

Communications Frameworks & Ecosystem Orchestration:

  • Develop robust communications architectures and ecosystem maps that define the role of different channels (paid, owned, earned) and content types across the consumer journey, encompassing Colgate’s Brand Experience planning process (touchpoints, roles, formats, KPIs, messaging, destinations).
  • Lead content briefing alongside creative teams and ensure timely delivery of key comms planning elements, including the creation of comms planning (Attention Consideration Purchase Loyalty) templates, asset lists, and toolkit production.
  • Oversee the integration of division-level initiatives (e.g., Ogilvy social strategy, OAC 1PD workstream) into comprehensive comms plans, ensuring seamless execution.

Client & Stakeholder Management:

  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to clients, presenting complex strategies with clarity and conviction, fostering strong relationships, and identifying opportunities for growth and innovation.
  • Manage the planning process end-to-end, coordinating crucial internal and external meetings (briefings, check-ins, creative strategy, market alignments), managing timelines, scope, expectations, and writing internal briefs.
  • Ensure market needs are thoroughly accounted for in division comms plans, acting as a key liaison.

Integrated Planning & Collaboration:

  • Collaborate seamlessly with your colleagues in media buying, creative, data sciences, analytics, and other specialist teams (e.g., WPPCP creative planners, WPPCP client teams, WPP Media Digital, Audience team, ACE team, Ogilvy), ensuring strategies are translated into effective and measurable execution within the BEP process.
  • Work closely with Channel specialists, including Retail/eCommerce, to develop integrated, omnichannel strategies and lead WM Hub teams on eCommerce and eRetail strategy.

Innovation & Future-Forward Thinking:

  • Stay at the forefront of evolving media landscapes, ad-tech, consumer behaviour shifts, and emerging platforms, proactively integrating new approaches into planning frameworks, specifically championing 'True Innovation' via target test-and-learn approaches.
  • Drive the evolution towards enhanced 'CX' by fostering closer integration of commerce with the ACE team and stronger insight capabilities, leveraging your internal understanding.
  • Contribute to adding innovation and challenging existing approaches in IMC briefs.

Team Development & Mentorship:

  • Guide, mentor, and inspire junior planners, fostering a culture of strategic thinking, creativity, and continuous professional development, and actively participating in upskilling brand teams.

Performance & Measurement:

  • Define clear KPIs, work with analytics teams to establish measurement frameworks, and contribute to post-campaign analysis to optimize future strategies and demonstrate ROI, including supplying data for MMM analyses for priority/lead markets and brands.

Thought Leadership:

  • Contribute to internal and external thought leadership initiatives, sharing best practices, case studies, and insights across the WPP network and industry, including contributing to professional strategy, 1PD, influencer, and special projects.
  • Actively participate in new business pitches, bringing strategic vision and innovative planning approaches to prospective clients.

Skills and Experience

Experience:

  • Progressive experience in media planning, communications planning, or strategic planning roles, with experience on multi market or global clients
  • Proven track record of developing and leading successful, integrated omnichannel communications strategies for major brands across multiple markets, with a strong emphasis on EMEA.
  • Demonstrated experience in a leadership role (director level), managing and mentoring strategic planning teams.
  • Strong background in digital media planning and strategy, with a solid understanding of traditional media.
  • Direct experience with Brand Ecosystem Planning (BEP) and Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC) frameworks is highly desirable.

 Skills & Knowledge:

  • Expertise in audience segmentation, consumer journey mapping, behavioral economics, and demonstrated proficiency in leveraging WPP's Audience Catalogue and proprietary tools.
  • Proficiency with media planning and research tools (e.g., Comscore, Nielsen, MRI, GWI), with a strong command of WPP proprietary tools like Connect+ (WPP Open).
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and compelling narratives.
  • Exceptional presentation and communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to articulate complex strategies clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Deep understanding of the ad-tech ecosystem, programmatic buying, social media platforms, emerging media channels, and the integration of Retail/eCommerce strategies.
  • Proven familiarity with WPP's internal ecosystem (e.g., Ogilvy social strategy, OAC 1PD, and ACE team functionalities) is key.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, particularly in managing complex processes, timelines, and deliverables (e.g., ACPL templates, asset lists) within our operational framework.
  • Highly collaborative, with a proven ability to work cross-functionally and build strong internal and external relationships across the WPP network (e.g., with WPPCP, WPP Media Digital, ACE team, Hubs).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Excel, Word).

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.  

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country. 

Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Tools & Systems
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We are looking for an experienced and versatile software engineer to work on the tools and systems that support Firefox engineering.

This is a broad software engineering role spanning internal engineering systems, developer tooling, workflow automation, and the infrastructure required to operate them. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development skills and meaningful experience deploying and operating production systems.

Our Cloud Engineering teams provide shared platforms and foundational services, while engineering teams own the applications and services they run on them. A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering.

You will work across projects and technical domains, joining teams or existing efforts when needed and independently taking on problems that require focused ownership.

We build in the open. Open source is fundamental to how we work, and contributing back to the broader open-source ecosystem is an important part of the role.

What you'll do:
  • Design, build, deploy, and operate software and systems supporting Firefox engineering.
  • Contribute to developer tooling, CI/CD, workflow automation, and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Own complex technical problems end-to-end across software, cloud, and operational layers, improving reliability, performance, observability, and cost efficiency.
  • Work with Firefox engineering, Cloud Engineering, IT, and other teams to solve problems that span technical and organizational boundaries.
  • Use telemetry, metrics, and data analysis to investigate problems and guide engineering decisions.
  • Contribute to architecture and technical strategy, identifying recurring problems and solutions that can be applied across teams.
What you'll bring:

Strong software engineering skills and substantial hands-on experience deploying and operating production systems are core requirements for this role. We do not expect you to be an expert in every technology or domain listed below.

  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with C++ or Rust is useful.
  • Experience building and deploying and operating production systems in cloud environments, including utilizing infrastructure as code such as Terraform.
  • Experience across several areas such as CI/CD, containers and orchestration, networking, databases, observability, or developer tooling.
  • Experience using data, telemetry, and metrics to investigate technical problems and make decisions.
  • Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use.
How you work:
  • You are comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems and getting them into a sustainable state.
  • You enjoy moving across projects and technical domains, taking ownership of problems and looking for patterns that make the next one easier to solve.
  • You work effectively across disciplines and can translate between software, infrastructure, and operational concerns.
  • You combine hands-on engineering with systems thinking and longer-term technical judgment.
  • You communicate openly, consistently, and respectfully, and enjoy teaching and helping others build skills in unfamiliar technical areas.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission.  We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws.  Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

title: Senior Consulting Systems Engineer Germany, Strategic Accounts (Automotive and Manufacturing)
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Senior Consulting Systems Engineer Germany, Strategic Accounts 

(Automotive)

Do you keep up with the latest trends, are you a disruptive thinker and do you have experience of driving cultural change in organisations? If Yes - then this is the right role for you.

 

The Strategic Accounts business is the growth area for Everpure and the Client Technical Director (CTD), known internally as a - Consulting System Engineer (CSE) - is a key role in engaging new and existing Automotive clients in conversations to help them transition from traditional storage-centric models to a modern data platform - unlocking the power of their data.

 

As Client Technical Director you are a senior level technical Solutions Architect who will work with and focus on Everpure’s Strategic clients -  for this role it will be German Automotive clients with a focus on southern Germany, plus other selected accounts. In turn, you will also work in collaboration with Everpure’s Enterprise and Field pre-sales and account teams 

You are expected also to have a detailed grasp of IT industry trends, broad and deep IT industry experience (especially Automotive, their Tier 1 suppliers and ecosystems, plus the wider Manufacturing supply chain and build demands) and a high degree of business acumen and will be working in the forefront of Everpure's global sales capability.

 

You will be required to work closely with your customer base (so frequent travel within Germany is a strong requirement), building a trusted relationship, identifying and quantifying outcome based opportunities that can be delivered from our portfolio.

 

You must be knowledgeable across industry, business, IT strategy, use cases and technology domains and be comfortable presenting to C-Suite clients, discussing process with business managers or working with developers on solution strategy, architecture and code, and with storage admins designing operating models – from boardroom to hackathon to storage ops. Critically you will be accustomed to creating a value proposition that is directly linked to a client’s business model, challenges and issues plus their future vision.

 

You will be an expert in quickly learning new business models and drivers and will be able to articulate, to multiple customer stakeholder personas across different regions and countries. This will include presenting and explaining the benefits and differentiators of our chosen technology, how our solution has been mapped to meet their industry, business and operational requirements, our implementation methods, and the proposed commercial and financial models.

Building and articulating financial and commercial models with their benefits to our customers, and internal stakeholders is a key aspect of the ever evolving role.

 

It is expected that you will be able to translate our core values, differentiators and capabilities across our portfolio, plus articulate previous customer success stories, benefits seen and acknowledged by customers with known outcomes to multiple levels of stakeholders within the strategic accounts.

You have gravitas and authenticity. You will be expected to have first class interpersonal skills combined with a comfortable, open and compelling communication and presentation style. You also bring a high degree of diplomacy and a strong EQ.  It is imperative that we can look at our value propositions from the viewpoint of our customers, therefore empathy is critical.

 

 SHOULD YOU ACCEPT THIS CHALLENGE, AS A CTD AT EVERPURE YOU WILL WORK ON...

  1. Use Case Development and Solution Definition:

Define end‑to‑end solutions and use cases that address the specific realities of German and global Automotives – from production and supply chain to digital services and connected vehicles.

Shape our global automotive strategy and footprint across the largest German OEMs and suppliers by mapping industry trends, business drivers, and technical requirements to Everpure’s portfolio and ecosystem.

Influence implementation methods, technology choices and commercial / financial models so that our solutions deliver clear, measurable outcomes for customers.

  1. Stakeholder Management:

Understand stakeholders, their drivers, challenges, their goals and expectations, and effectively communicate the right messages to them. You will spend a large portion of your time with your customers face to face, (in and around Germany primarily, but also globally covering the leading German Automotive accounts), your partners, Alliances, Global Integrators and key stakeholders.

  1. Financial Acumen:

Calculate Total Cost of Ownership scenarios for customers, explaining how they align with their challenges and Everpure’s benefits.

  1. Leadership and Collaboration:

Lead large IT projects, establish yourself as a thought leader and trusted advisor, collaborate with sales, engineering, and product management teams. Have experience of working across multiple global and local partners.

  1. Collateral Production:

Create client collateral, including presentations, papers, demonstrations, proofs of concepts, and contribute to joint offerings with other Everpure teams.

  1. Sales Guidance:

Guide the Sales team in positioning, shaping and closing the right solutions in a competitive environment.

  1. Technical Leadership:

Provide technical leadership and mentoring for the local and regional Systems Engineering organisation.

Represent Pure at industry events, field marketing activities and communities (including those focused on women in tech and diverse talent).

  1. Market Insight:

Track key trends in Automotive and Manufacturing (e.g. software‑defined vehicles ADAS & AD, Industry 4.0, sustainability, data sovereignty and primacy & AI) and connect them to Everpure’s technology strategy.

Understand the competitive landscape and be able to articulate where Pure differentiates and how our solutions support the German market’s specific requirements.

Bring back customer and market insights to influence our roadmap and go‑to‑market.

  1. Culture & Inclusion:

Help maintain and evolve Everpure’s technical and customer‑first culture.

Act as a role model who creates inclusive environments, supports diverse talent, and helps us attract and retain top technical people

 

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE...

1.Technical Expertise:

Strong technical background across infrastructure and data: storage, compute, databases, networking, virtualisation and/or cloud‑native architectures.

Solid experience with data management and storage technologies, and how they support mission‑critical workloads in Automotive and Manufacturing.

Understanding of key manufacturing processes and outcomes, and a deep appreciation of the Automotive value chain – OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, production plants, logistics and digital services.

  1. Versatility:

Familiarity with areas such as data & analytics / data science, modern IT architecture modelling, Agile and DevOps, automation and infrastructure as code, IT operations and IT security.

Ability to quickly learn new platforms, tools and architectures and translate them into simple, business‑relevant language.

  1. Strategic Thinking:

Experience working with large, global or strategic accounts – ideally in or with German enterprise customers (automotive experience is beneficial)

Ability to move comfortably between big‑picture strategy and hands‑on detail, and to structure complex problems into clear options and recommendations.

  1. Communication Skills:

Outstanding communication skills in German and English (Native/Bilingual German and business‑fluent English required).

Confidence in presenting to C‑Level, senior business leaders and technical teams – and in facilitating workshops where different perspectives need to be heard.

High emotional intelligence, empathy and diplomacy; you naturally build trust and foster collaborative discussions.

  1. Industry Knowledge:

Strong understanding of commercial and disruptive technology trends in the Automotive and Manufacturing markets in Germany, with existing relationships within southern Germany automotives strongly preferred.

Knowledge of major competitors and partner ecosystems, and the ability to position Pure’s differentiators for the right use cases.

  1. Learning Orientation:

A growth and learning orientation – you actively invest in your own development and stay curious about new technologies, methods and industry trends.

Willingness to dedicate a minimum of 10% of your time to training, certifications and participation in industry and community events.

#LI-HYBRID

 

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
  • Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:

OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

description:
Enterprise Account Executive – SAP Ecosystem & Digital Transformation for Benelux  & Nordics (m/f/d)

Position Summary

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive, reporting to VP of Global GTM .We are seeking an elite, high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business acquisition across top-tier accounts. Combining large-enterprise sophistication with an aggressive, entrepreneurial hunting mindset, you will architect transformational security deals, engage C-level stakeholders, and position business resilience for the world’s most mission-critical ERP environments.

Key Responsibilities

Drive Strategic Revenue: Own the full sales lifecycle for Global 2000 accounts, positioning the Onapsis Platform as the essential security layer for SAP and Business Critical Applications. 

 

The SAP "Triple Threat": 

  1. Direct Sales: Manage complex, high-value "land and expand" cycles.
  2. SAP Co-Sell: Partner with SAP Account Executives (AEs) and Enterprise Architects  to attach Onapsis to S/4HANA and RISE migrations.
  3. GSI Alignment: Orchestrate go-to-market strategies with Global Systems Integrators (Accenture, Deloitte, IBM, PwC) who are leading the world's largest SAP transformations.

C-Suite Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to CISOs and CIOs, translating technical vulnerabilities into business risks (e.g., SOX compliance, financial downtime, and data integrity).

Territory Orchestration: Develop and execute an annual territory plan focused on "White Space" analysis within the SAP installed base.

Forecast Accuracy: Maintain a high level of "Sales Hygiene" within CRM, delivering predictable weekly and monthly forecasts aligned with SAP’s rigorous reporting standards.

Required Skills/Experience

  • Proven Enterprise Track Record: 7–10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, with a proven history of selling complex software solutions within the SAP ecosystem (either at SAP or a top-tier partner).
  • Cloud Transformation Expert: Deep understanding of the RISE with SAP framework, Clean Core strategy, and the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).
  • Consistent High Achiever: Consistent record of quota over-achievement, regularly closing seven-figure ARR deals across Global 2000 accounts with complex buying committees.
  • Alliance Savvy: Demonstrated success in "partner-first" selling, particularly with GSIs and SAP’s regional field teams.
  • Communication: Exceptional executive presence; ability to move seamlessly from a technical discussion with a Basis Lead to a strategic ROI pitch with a CFO.
  • Ability to travel: We believe that our business is a people business and that trust is built in person. Between 25-50% travel required.
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Proactive self-starter with the drive to build a territory from scratch and take full ownership of business growth.
  • Language: Professional fluency in English. Additional regional language skills are a strong plus (written and spoken).

Our offer:

  • You can expect a job with responsible tasks and creative opportunities, and an attractive salary.
  • You have flexible working hours with us. In addition, you can work remotely from other EU countries by arrangement.
  • Equity in a late-stage, high-growth leader backed by top-tier VC/PE firms.
  • The chance to represent the only cybersecurity solution endorsed by SAP.
  • Furthermore, you can expect an innovative and attractive workplace with flat hierarchies and respectful and solution-oriented communication.

 

About Onapsis

Onapsis protects the business applications that run the global economy. The Onapsis Platform delivers vulnerability management, change assurance, and continuous compliance for business applications from leading vendors such as SAP, Oracle, and others. The Onapsis Platform is powered by the Onapsis Research Labs, the team responsible for the discovery and mitigation of more than 1,000 zero-day vulnerabilities in business applications.

Onapsis is headquartered in Boston, MA, with offices in Dallas, TX, Heidelberg, Germany, Bucharest, Romania, and Buenos Aires, Argentina, and proudly serves hundreds of the world’s leading brands, including close to 30% of the Forbes Global 100, six of the top 10 automotive companies, five of the top 10 chemical companies, four of the top 10 technology companies, and three of the top 10 oil and gas companies.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager | Germany | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

 

The Opportunity:

We’re looking for an enthusiastic, tech-forward product marketer to grow our Observability products by boldly positioning them and running campaigns to attract, convert and retain customers. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will be in charge of the messaging and positioning for a broad product area. Then you’ll work closely with product managers and the marketing team to deliver campaigns, content, events, and training that help buyers buy (and sellers sell) our value.

Product Marketing lives within the Product org rather than the Marketing org at Grafana Labs, and we think differently about the job. Rather than purely executing launches or campaigns, we want PMMs to teach product managers and engineers in our org how to think about growth and demand, and to codify product marketing knowledge into AI-forward tools and processes that anyone in the organization can use. For example, we all contribute product information to a shared knowledge base, which we use to generate enablement materials and decks.

Grafana Labs is a fast-paced and growing organization. As such, this role requires strategic skills, an interest in teaching, and hands-on tactical execution (blogs, webinar outlines, video scripts, etc). Our team is full of people who crave impact and independence - if you are seeking a role with narrow scope where you run a defined playbook, this is not the job for you.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Actively partner with and teach product managers to define product value, messaging, and go-to-market strategy, from competitive positioning to sales enablement collateral.
  • Partner with product management, engineering and various go-to-market functions to create materials that help customers evaluate and adopt our products: reference architectures, implementation guides, detailed product information and more.
  • Own customer lifecycle campaigns (competitive positioning, retention, upsell/cross-sell) to strategically shape marketing programs and drive growth across the entire customer journey.
  • Conduct market and customer research to understand pain points, competition and opportunities.
  • Teach go-to-market and sales teams our products’ capabilities and the value they provide, deliver training and enablement, ensure customer facing teams are able to effectively engage with customers, partners, and prospects.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 4+ years of relevant experience (product marketing, solutions marketing, product management)
  • Experience with marketing and selling to a technical audience
  • A passion for open source, cloud native, and infrastructure technologies 
  • Proven ability to take on complex projects and efficiently drive them from start to finish
  • Ability to clearly articulate the value of technical products to customers and sellers alike
  • Experience leading product or feature launches autonomously as well as part of a team
  • Experience working with AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to automate messaging and workflows
  • Comfort working with a variety of internal and external stakeholders in complicated processes
  • Strong product and technical curiosity that translate to clear packaging, positioning, and messaging
  • Demonstrated quantitative analytical skills for analyzing campaign performance, evaluating lifecycle metrics, and making data-driven recommendations.
  • Exceptional writing and communication skills
  • A high “say-do” ratio in executing and delivering impact 

Compensation & Rewards:

In Germany, the base compensation range for this role is EUR 97,034 - EUR 116,441. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process.   • Manage project- and account-level escalations, ensuring rapid resolution and maintaining customer confidence
  • Position consulting, training, success tiers, and additional solutions proactively to ensure successful outcomes and long-term customer retention
