title: Analytics Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Allow us to introduce ourselves

Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions.

We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over 260 employees spread across 13 countries (we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from +190 markets, globally.

Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? 🚀

Here at Appinio, we value transparency in our recruitment process, and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together: here

Your mission as an Analytics Engineer

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer (m/f/d) with strong data engineering skills to join our Data team and help build a scalable, reliable, and well-structured data foundation across Appinio.
In this role, you will design and maintain clean, scalable data models that make data easy to access, understand, and use across the organisation. You will use SQL, dbt, and Python to transform raw data into meaningful datasets, develop automated workflows, and ensure consistency and reliability across our data warehouse.
Beyond data modelling, you will contribute to building, maintaining, and optimising data pipelines and integrations. You will work with APIs, databases, and third-party data sources to ensure reliable data ingestion, troubleshoot pipeline issues, and improve the overall stability and performance of our data infrastructure.
Working closely with Analytics, Product, Engineering, and business teams, you will help define and standardise key business metrics such as revenue, bookings, and churn, ensuring a single source of truth across the company. You will also take ownership of data quality through automated testing, validation, and monitoring across the data lifecycle.
You will explore and leverage AI-powered tools to improve development workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance data engineering and analytics processes. You will also help prepare our data foundation for AI-driven analytics by ensuring that data models, business definitions, and documentation are structured, consistent, and accessible.
You will contribute to documentation, performance optimisation, and the continuous improvement of our data stack, helping us build a robust and scalable data platform that enables teams across Appinio to make faster, more informed decisions.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Data Modeling: Design, build, and maintain clean, scalable data models in the data warehouse using SQL and dbt, making data accessible and reliable for analysts and business users.
  • Data Transformation: Develop and maintain data transformation workflows, turning raw data from multiple sources into structured, analytics-ready datasets.
  • Data Pipelines & Integration: Build, maintain, and troubleshoot data pipelines and integrations, ensuring reliable data ingestion from APIs, databases, and third-party systems into the data warehouse.
  • Data Quality & Testing: Ensure data accuracy and reliability by implementing automated tests, validations, monitoring, and proactive issue resolution across data pipelines and models.
  • Documentation: Document data models, pipelines, business definitions, and transformation logic to ensure transparency, maintainability, and knowledge sharing.
  • Business Logic Ownership: Define, implement, and standardize key business metrics (e.g. revenue, bookings, churn) to ensure consistency across reporting and analytics.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with analysts, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to understand data requirements and deliver reliable, scalable data solutions.
  • Performance & Infrastructure Optimization: Optimize SQL queries, dbt models, and data pipelines for performance, scalability, and efficient use of data warehouse resources.

You will thrive in this role if

  • Strong SQL & Data Modeling Skills: You have excellent SQL skills and hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable data models in a modern data warehouse.
  • Experience with dbt: You have practical experience using dbt to develop, test, document, and maintain reliable data transformation workflows.
  • Data Engineering & Python: You are proficient in Python and have experience building, maintaining, and troubleshooting data pipelines, including integrations with APIs, databases, and third-party systems.
  • Data Warehousing Knowledge: You understand modern data warehouse architectures and have experience working with cloud-based solutions such as Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, or BigQuery.
  • Data Quality & Reliability: You have a strong understanding of data quality principles, automated testing, validation, and monitoring, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
  • Business Understanding: You can translate business requirements into reliable data models and clearly defined metrics, balancing technical quality with practical business needs.
  • Problem-Solving & Ownership: You are analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of technical challenges, investigating root causes, and developing sustainable solutions.
  • Collaboration & Communication: You communicate technical concepts clearly, work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and enjoy collaborating across teams.
  • AI & Automation Mindset: You are curious about AI-powered development tools and actively explore opportunities to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase productivity.

What’s in it for you?

  • Flexibility Policy - Average is 30 days taken, however, we do not have a hard cap of number of vacation days as we know life happens
  • Temporary work from abroad - If you're based in the EU, you can work outside your country of residence for up to 180 days per year
  • All the hardware you need and your own MacBook
  • If you are located in Hamburg or Berlin, you'll get a Deutschland ticket or access to a mobility budget with the NAVIT app to get you to and from the office space
  • Subsidised Urban Sports Club or ClassPass membership based on location
  • In case you’re located in one of the cities where most of our fellow Appinioneers are (Hamburg, Berlin, Munich, London, Madrid, Barcelona, or New York), you can get access to our Co-working spaces

Additional role details

  • This is a fully remote position open to candidates based in Germany, the UK, Portugal, the Netherlands, and Spain
  • This role will report directly to our Team Lead, Business Intelligence

Our interview process

  • Screening Call with the Talent Acquisition team
  • Hiring Manager interview
  • Case Study 
  • Executive Interview
  • References

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.

SumUp's tax function is scaling to match a business that now spans more than 40 entities. This role is a senior partner to the Head of Tax across the Group's tax agenda.   • Lead delivery of SumUp's tax agenda across corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and indirect tax, within the Group tax strategy set by the Head of Tax
  • Oversee the transfer pricing framework and its implementation, and propose improvements to both substance and automation

  • Act as the first point of contact for tax authority audits and controversies, keeping the Head of Tax aligned on positions and exposure
  • Provide independent technical judgement on high-stakes tax positions, challenging assumptions and bringing options and recommendations to the Head of Tax

  • Senior tax experience across corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and indirect tax in a multinational, combining strategic leadership with hands-on technical delivery. You're comfortable working through the detail yourself, from modelling and documentation to reviewing returns, and you don't need to hand every technical question to an adviser.
  • A track record of building in-house tax expertise, with a preference for developing capability internally and using external advisers selectively, for specialist opinions and peer review rather than day-to-day analysis.
  • Proven track record developing senior tax team members, including people leadership, prioritisation, and performance development.
  • Strong knowledge of European corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and cross-border structuring, along with Pillar Two, CbCR, and EU Directives.

About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

This position is Paris-based, with relocation support available.

Team

For this position, you will be an integral part of a newly established internal studio, a dynamic and focused team dedicated to one of our most promising prototype in scale. This studio is specifically chartered to improve this high-potential game up to the successful and market-ready title it is meant to become.

You will be part of the team building Draft Showdown, a turn-based multiplayer game, working alongside its client engineers and game designers as a full member of the game team. You will be part of a small group owning the backend that this game needs as its requirements become more specific and demanding.

You’ll also be plugged into Voodoo's shared gaming backend platform - the same architecture and patterns that power titles like Mob Control and Block Jam 3D - building on it and contributing back, in close collaboration with the wider backend team. You get the focus and ownership of a dedicated game engineer with the leverage and support of a battle-tested platform behind you.

This is a pivotal hire: Draft Showdown is moving towards competitive multiplayer, which means moving game logic from the client to the server. They are also implementing cheat detection safeguards to the game.
You will be central to that transition.

Role

You will design and build the server-side foundation that takes Draft Showdown from a client-authoritative game to a competitive, server-validated one. The current game computes everything on the device - progression, economy, and match outcomes alike, which won't hold up for competitive PvP. Your job is to change that.

Working closely with client developers and game designers from feature design through delivery, validation and iteration, you will:

  • Build server-side validation for the metagame - currency, card upgrades, chest opens, and progression - staged by risk, replicating economy and reward logic on the server.

  • Move toward server authority for competitive features, where game state lives in one place and can be trusted.

  • Implement and improve matchmaking and cheat detection safeguards for a Deterministic lockstep PvP architecture

  • Design APIs and player-state management that the Unity client integrates against, and help shape how client and server split responsibilities.

The responsibilities are cross-functional, ranging from infrastructure, API design & coding all the way to client-side integration (we are using Golang).

To succeed in this role, you will need to have passion for everything you do. You love to write code that scales to millions of users, are skilled at requirements gathering, champion new tech initiatives & leverage existing solutions.

Profile

  • 5+ years of backend development experience

  • Strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals

  • Extreme fluency in Golang (at least 1 year in a professional environment)

  • Mastery of SQL and NoSQL

  • Background in high-scale systems

  • Understanding of Unix-like environments

  • AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work

  • Experience working in cross-functional agile teams

  • Strong analytical skills with a track record of solving complex problems related to scalability, performance, and integration in high-stakes environments.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, capable of influencing teams and interfacing effectively with various stakeholders.

  • Ability to be self sufficient and work autonomously.

  • A deep interest in game development is a plus.

  • Based or willing to relocate in Paris

Benefits

  • Best-in-class compensation

  • Other benefits according to the country you reside

En complément, nous vous invitons à prendre connaissance des actions de sensibilisation et mobilisation en consultant : l’Espace du bénévolat et de la sensibilisation pour Handicap International . Activité 2 : Vous participez à l’organisation d’autres événements de Handicap International · Congrès des Notaires : contribuer à la définition et à l’adaptation des messages clés, à la conception du stand et du parcours de sensibilisation, à la préparation des supports, du matériel et d’un kit d’animation, ainsi qu’à l’organisation. · Vœux 2028 : participer à la recherche et à la sélection d’un lieu insolite adapté à l’événement, imaginer des propositions d’animation et contribuer à l’identification, à la consultation et au suivi des prestataires. · Plus largement, apporter un appui à la coordination, à la logistique et au suivi des événements transversaux de l’Association Nationale France. Vous travaillez avec l’équipe qui conçoit aujourd’hui les équipements, et avec le bureau d’études d’un fabricant partenaire qui réalise la conception détaillée et les plans de fabrication. Choisir les capteurs adaptés et les intégrer ; résoudre les enjeux d’étanchéité, de tenue en température et en pression. Consulter fournisseurs et sous-traitants, suivre la fabrication des pièces. Monter, instrumenter et tester vous-même vos équipements au laboratoire ; interpréter les mesures et améliorer. Améliorer l’ergonomie des équipements existants et transférer les équipements validés à l’équipe d’essais. Rédiger la documentation technique et contribuer à la protection de la propriété intellectuelle. Requirements Indispensable Conception mécanique d’équipements, avec une CAO 3D (aucun logiciel imposé). Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure physique et physico-chimique : choisir et intégrer, pas fabriquer. Rigueur, autonomie, communication proactive des difficultés. Un plus Anglais technique (échanges écrits avec des fournisseurs étrangers). Mise en plan, notions de matériaux et d’isolation thermique. Expérience en pression ou température. Formation et expérience Diplôme d’ingénieur (bac +5) en mécanique, génie physique, instrumentation ou mesures physiques. Un parcours associant mécanique et mesures physiques (BUT Mesures physiques puis école d’ingénieurs en mécanique) est particulièrement apprécié. Environ 5 ans d’expérience en conception d’équipements, bureau d’études ou R&D ; profils plus juniors étudiés. Poste orienté conception et terrain : une thèse n’est pas requise. Conditions Sur site. Manutention occasionnelle de pièces métalliques lourdes avec moyens de levage. Intéressement Rémunération : 36 – 48 k€ brut annuel selon expérience Benefits Vous rejoindrez une entreprise à taille humaine où chaque développement compte : vos équipements seront directement utilisés pour des projets de R&D menés pour des clients internationaux. raw.jobDescription:
About Medium

Medium is one of the world's most influential writing platforms, connecting millions of readers with ideas that matter. We're a small, dedicated team that cares deeply and takes real ownership of the problems we tackle, moving fast while building something that lasts. Our actions and decision-making are guided by four principles: Humans First, Deepen Understanding, Orient for Impact, and Ladder Together.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer to help build and evolve the Android experience that millions of readers and writers rely on every day. You'll own Android features end to end. That means digging into what users actually need, building it, shipping it, and paying attention to how it actually performs once it's out in the world. You'll work closely with our design team the whole way through.

This is a product engineering role at heart. We don't have a dedicated product team, so you won't be handed a fully-specified ticket and told to go build it. Rather, you'll be the one figuring out what's worth building in the first place, partnering with design and other engineers, and making good calls when the ask is vague or doesn't quite solve the real problem. Android is where you'll spend most of your time, but we want someone who can also hold their own on at least one other platform, whether that's web, iOS, or backend. That range matters: it means you can see how a feature fits into the bigger picture, make good calls about where logic should live, and work credibly with whoever owns that other platform.

What You'll Do

  • Own Android features end to end. Understand the problem, build it, ship it, and see how it actually does
  • Shape what gets built, not just how it gets built. Push back on scope, propose simpler solutions, and raise platform constraints early rather than after the fact
  • Write idiomatic, well-tested Kotlin and Compose UI that fits naturally into the team's existing architecture
  • Work directly with iOS, web, or backend engineers depending on what a feature needs, and help decide where functionality should live
  • Partner with our leadership team, design team, and engineers in the US and France to turn a rough idea into something that actually ships well on Android
  • Bring superb judgment to ambiguous requests. You can ask good questions, spot edge cases early, and propose reasonable first steps when the full scope isn't clear yet
  • Own shaping product and feature spaces, maintaining and driving a sense of forward momentum even when the final destination of your work may not be clear
  • Help raise the bar for the mobile team on code quality, testing, and product thinking
  • Attend Medium's twice-yearly, in-person offsites (hosted in locations around the U.S.)

What You Have

  • You've spent several years building production Android apps and you're genuinely fluent in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, coroutines and Flow, and modern Android architecture
  • You're an expert with all things Android engineering, but you can also hold your own on at least one other platform (web, iOS, or backend) and can work credibly there when a feature calls for it
  • You think like a product engineer. You don't just build what's asked, but can own and appreciate the impact at a product impact altitude of your work.You understand the problem underneath the request, push back when something doesn't add up, and care about whether it actually worked once it shipped
  • You've worked closely with designers and engineers on other platforms before. You're good at explaining a technical tradeoff in a way that actually lands for someone who isn't an engineer
  • You have good instincts about systems, you're adaptable, and you're genuinely eager to learn. You can advocate for an approach while staying open to a better one. We care a lot about collaboration and psychological safety here. We want someone who adds to it
  • You have the ability to push forward in ambiguity and make great trade off decisions to keep a project moving

Nice to Haves

  • Experience using AI to improve a team's leverage, reach, output and impact
  • You've owned product direction yourself rather than just executing someone else's plan
  • You personally use Medium and are genuinely excited to contribute to its mission, which is empowering humans to write meaningfully for other humans

Benefits

In addition to the new skills you'll pick up, here's what else you'll enjoy by working at Medium:

  • Working with a fully distributed team: We’re fully remote and have teammates across the U.S. & France
  • Healthcare benefits covered at 100% for employees and 80% for dependents
  • Generous parental leave policy
  • Mental health support through Spring Health (or find a provider through Rula or Kaiser Mental Health Network)
  • Financial wellness support through Northstar
  • Stipends for co-working, professional development, wifi, and a one-time home office bonus
  • Unlimited PTO and standard company holidays
  • A discounted Medium membership

Why Medium

We're a small team doing meaningful work. Beyond guiding your team's execution, you'll have real influence over engineering strategy, culture, and direction. You'll work alongside people who are genuinely good at what they do and who care about building something worth building.

At Medium, inclusion, diversity, and equity are core to how we work and what we build. We believe a more inclusive team creates a better product—one that’s intuitive, thoughtful, and serves a wide range of users. We strive to foster a supportive, fun, and challenging environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive.

We welcome applicants from all walks of life and strongly encourage those from historically underrepresented groups to apply. Our hiring process is built to ensure fairness and equal opportunity for everyone. Even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your perspective and passion matter more than checking every box.

Learn more about our mission, operating principles, and culture:

  • Yes to a diverse community
  • Be part of a better internet
  • Medium Rules
  • Operating Principles

Read about our story here.

Read our guidance on AI use for candidates. We believe human ideas have the power to change how people think, for the better. That belief shapes how we hire. We use AI tools ourselves, but we’ve thought carefully about where it adds value and where it gets in the way of something important.

Salary Range

$165,000—$215,000 USD

GDPR Notice

We will process your personal data as part of our recruitment process, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). For details on how we use your data, including the legal bases for processing, how long we retain it, and your rights under GDPR, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

We may retain your information for future job opportunities based on our legitimate interest in building a talent pool. You can object to this at any time by contacting us at recruiting@medium.com.

CCPA Notice

If you are a California resident, you have rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA). These include the right to know what personal information we collect about you, the right to request deletion or correction of your data, and the right to opt out of certain uses.

During the hiring process, we may collect personal information such as your name, contact details, resume/CV, employment history, education background, and any information gathered through interviews or assessments. We may share this information with service providers who support our recruitment process, in compliance with CCPA/CPRA. This information is used solely for recruitment and hiring purposes.

We do not sell or share your personal information as defined under CCPA/CPRA. Candidate data is retained for up to 48 months for our legitimate business purposes and in accordance with applicable laws.

To exercise your rights or request more information, please contact us at recruiting@medium.com. This notice can also be found on our Privacy Notice.

We are hiring a Backend Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable backend services. You will own APIs, data models, and integrations with blockchain and third-party systems. Stack is not limited to Node — strong engineers in Rust, Go, Java, Python, or Ruby are welcome. This is a hands-on role focused on reliability, security, and production readiness.

What you'll do

Build and maintain backend services in one or more of: Node.js, Rust, Go, Java, Python, Ruby

Design REST and/or GraphQL APIs

Model data and own PostgreSQL / Redis (or equivalent) usage

Integrate blockchain APIs, wallets, and external services

Implement auth, permissions, and operational controls

Write tests, improve observability, and participate in reviews

Ship production-ready services with CI/CD

What we're looking for

Must-have experience and skills for this role.

3+ years of backend engineering experience

Strong proficiency in at least one of: Node.js/TypeScript, Rust, Go, Java, Python, or Ruby

Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and caching

Solid understanding of REST APIs and system design basics

Experience integrating external APIs or microservices

Strong coding fundamentals and production debugging skills

Nice to have

Proficiency across multiple backend languages

Web3 integrations (ethers.js, smart contract APIs, chain clients)

Event-driven or distributed systems experience

AWS / GCP familiarity

Fintech or consulting experience

Tech stack

Node.js · TypeScript

Rust

Go

Java

Python

Ruby

PostgreSQL · Redis

Docker · AWS / GCP

Why join

Work on modern Web3, RWA, and digital products

High ownership and visible product impact

Close collaboration with engineering, product, and design

Fast-paced environment with real production systems

Remote-friendly across global time zones

What success looks like

Stable APIs in production

Clear data models and service boundaries

Reliable integrations with blockchain and third-party systems

Low operational noise and strong code quality

Hiring process

Application review

Technical discussion (backend + system design)

Final discussion

Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic SDLC - (EMEA Only)

An overview of this role

GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.

You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.

Why this role exists

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.

What you’ll do

Product contribution

  • Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.
  • Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.
  • Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.

Strategic technical stewardship

  • Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.
  • Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.
  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.
  • Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.
  • Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle

  • Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.
  • Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.
  • Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.

Thought leadership

  • Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach.
  • Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.
  • Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.
  • Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.

What you’ll bring

  • Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.
  • Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.
  • Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.
  • Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.
  • Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.
  • Experience working with strategic customers or senior technical stakeholders in ambiguous, high-impact situations.
  • The ability to coordinate across product, engineering, field, and customer teams without formal authority.
  • Strong written communication and sound judgment, including the ability to create technical narratives and distinguish reusable product work from customer-specific customization.

Strongly preferred qualifications

  • Direct experience with GitLab as a platform, including GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, or GitLab Self-Managed.
  • Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools.
  • Deep familiarity with Git internals, repository performance, large-scale Git usage patterns, or GitLab Runner behavior.
  • Experience creating technical thought-leadership materials, such as whitepapers, technical talks, architecture frameworks, requests for comments, public technical writing, or internal strategy documents.
  • A background in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or distributed systems.
  • Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments.

Technologies and domains

Directly relevant technologies and domains include:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Go
  • AI-assisted development and the agentic SDLC
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis and Sidekiq
  • Git internals
  • GitLab CI/CD and Runner architecture
  • Kubernetes and containers
  • Terraform
  • Linux, networking, observability, and performance analysis
  • Vue and TypeScript
  • APIs and automation
  • DevSecOps governance, security, and compliance

What this role is not

This role isn't:

  • A generic field engineering role.
  • A proof-of-concept factory.
  • A replacement for Solutions Architecture, Customer Success Architecture, Customer Success Management, Professional Services, Support, SRE, Product, or Engineering.
  • A customer-specific customization function.
  • Unbilled Professional Services.
  • A requirements-gathering role that only escalates to Product.
  • An AI evangelism role disconnected from product execution.

Success measures

Success in this role may include:

  • Stabilizing strategic customer adoption or retention risks.
  • Fixing product bugs or contributing features.
  • Removing AI adoption blockers for strategic accounts.
  • Creating reusable implementation patterns and transitioning them to long-term owners.
  • Producing or enabling Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, or technical narratives.
  • Resolving cross-functional customer challenges without creating permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.
  • Equipping Product, Engineering, Support, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and SA teams with better guidance based on learning from the field.
  • Increasing adoption and effective use of GitLab capabilities, especially GitLab Duo and GitLab Duo Agent Platform, in targeted accounts.

About the team

The Forward Deployed Engineering team connects strategic customer needs with GitLab product execution. The team works directly with customers and across GitLab to resolve complex adoption challenges, contribute durable product improvements, and create reusable technical guidance. Its goal is to stabilize urgent situations, improve the product, and transition ongoing ownership to the appropriate team rather than create a permanent dependency.

Ideal candidate profile

You're a Staff-level product or platform engineer who can operate in the field without becoming field-only. You're comfortable reading traces, writing production code, debugging architecture, discussing AI governance, leading a customer technical session, opening a merge request, outlining a whitepaper, and coordinating across teams to achieve a strategic customer outcome.

You're not simply a strong communicator with technical awareness. You're a credible engineer with the judgment, presence, and narrative ability to turn customer reality into product contributions, adoption guidance, and company-level thought leadership.

We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience. Many successful candidates don't meet every qualification. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply and let our recruiting team assess your application.

title: Engineering Manager
description: At Signifyd , we help merchants confidently grow their businesses by building trusted relationships with their customers. Our advanced technology, combined with a team genuinely invested in our clients’ success, creates frictionless shopping experiences, approving more good orders, protecting revenue, and keeping customers happy. Trusted by thousands of leading merchants across more than 100 countries, we securely process billions of transactions each year. Our people are the heart of everything we do, driving our mission forward with commitment, empathy, and creativity. Join us on our mission to empower confident, fraud-free commerce by helping online retailers provide superior customer experiences and eliminate fraud. Learn about our company values here ! Role Overview Signifyd uses the latest in AI and machine learning technology to give our ecommerce customers the confidence they need to do business free from fears of fraud and other forms of ecommerce abuse. In order to do this we have to continually innovate and nowhere is this more important than in our modeling space. The modeling group creates, deploys and runs the models and services that keep us a step ahead and right now we need an engineering manager to help us build our next generation technology. The successful candidate will lead a team of engineers who will partner with our AI group and engineering as a whole to help bring ideas from conception to production, while ensuring the systems we already have continue to run smoothly. It’s a role for someone who can operate comfortably on both sides of the technical/business line, contributing to technical discussions but people-focused enough to build the relationships between engineering, our AI lab, product and our risk management organization. You will work daily with data scientists, machine learning engineers, product owners and other cross-functional stakeholders whose work depends on your team's systems. Success means being a trusted translator and partner across all of these groups, not just a manager of your own team's output. Your core responsibilities are delivery, fostering innovation and people leadership. How hands-on you get as part of that is up to you but you will be expected to drive closure on technical decisions and implementation. Key Responsibilities (outcome and accountability) 1. Team Leadership & Growth Manage, coach and grow a team of engineers, providing regular feedback, career development while ensuring performance remains high. Build a healthy team culture with clear ownership, sustainable pace and high standards for quality and craftsmanship. Recruit and onboard new engineers as needed and develop technical leadership within the team. 2. Stakeholder & Relationship Management Manage competing priorities and expectations across multiple stakeholder groups, building trust through fostering mutual understanding, delivering consistently and communicating transparently. Represent the team's roadmap, capacity and risks in cross-functional planning and prioritization discussions. 3. Technical Engagement & Decision-Making Drive technical discussions and design reviews, with enough depth to understand the implications of key decisions on reliability, scalability and production outcomes. Partner with engineers on architecture and design choices, asking the right questions rather than dictating solutions. Ensure the team's technical decisions are well understood by, and defensible to, other stakeholders. 4. AI-Enabled Ways of Working Model and champion effective use of AI tools across the team's day-to-day work, including AI-assisted research, administrative workflows, and code generation. Help the team develop good judgment about how to balance the productivity gains AI can bring against the risks it introduces. Continuously look for ways AI tooling can improve team efficiency, code quality, and decision-making, and share what's working with peers. Manage effectively through the major changes AI is bringing to the industry. 5. Delivery & Operational Rigor Own delivery of the team's roadmap balancing feature work, technical debt and reliability commitments. Establish and maintain appropriate quality, testing and monitoring practices. Provide clear, proactive communication on progress, risks and blockers to stakeholders and leadership. Define metrics as needed and develop an understanding of why we did or didn’t hit our targets. Qualifications & Skills (experience / depth) Experience 5+ years working as a software engineer. Some of that experience should be in the ML sphere. This should not be your first time managing and we’d prefer at least 4 years of experience managing engineers directly in an ML focused domain. Technical & AI Fluency Comfortable engaging in technical discussions on architecture, data flows, and system design. Demonstrable experience using AI tools in a professional capacity for research, administration and code generation with a clear point of view on how to use them responsibly and cost-effectively. Strong knowledge of software development best practices, cloud computing platforms, big data technologies, MLOps toolkits, and SLO-driven reliability management. Experience working with at least one of Databricks, Spark, Airflow, Vertex and the GCP technology stack in general is preferred. Stakeholder Management & Communication Strong track record managing relationships with a diverse set of technical and non-technical stakeholders. raw.jobDescription:
At Signifyd, we help merchants confidently grow their businesses by building trusted relationships with their customers. Our advanced technology, combined with a team genuinely invested in our clients’ success, creates frictionless shopping experiences, approving more good orders, protecting revenue, and keeping customers happy.

Trusted by thousands of leading merchants across more than 100 countries, we securely process billions of transactions each year. Our people are the heart of everything we do, driving our mission forward with commitment, empathy, and creativity. Join us on our mission to empower confident, fraud-free commerce by helping online retailers provide superior customer experiences and eliminate fraud. Learn about our company values here!

Role Overview

Signifyd uses the latest in AI and machine learning technology to give our ecommerce customers the confidence they need to do business free from fears of fraud and other forms of ecommerce abuse. In order to do this we have to continually innovate and nowhere is this more important than in our modeling space. The modeling group creates, deploys and runs the models and services that keep us a step ahead and right now we need an engineering manager to help us build our next generation technology. The successful candidate will lead a team of engineers who will partner with our AI group and engineering as a whole to help bring ideas from conception to production, while ensuring the systems we already have continue to run smoothly. It’s a role for someone who can operate comfortably on both sides of the technical/business line, contributing to technical discussions but people-focused enough to build the relationships between engineering, our AI lab, product and our risk management organization.

You will work daily with data scientists, machine learning engineers, product owners and other cross-functional stakeholders whose work depends on your team's systems. Success means being a trusted translator and partner across all of these groups, not just a manager of your own team's output.

Your core responsibilities are delivery, fostering innovation and people leadership. How hands-on you get as part of that is up to you but you will be expected to drive closure on technical decisions and implementation.

Key Responsibilities (outcome and accountability)

1. Team Leadership & Growth

  • Manage, coach and grow a team of engineers, providing regular feedback, career development while ensuring performance remains high.
  • Build a healthy team culture with clear ownership, sustainable pace and high standards for quality and craftsmanship.
  • Recruit and onboard new engineers as needed and develop technical leadership within the team.

2. Stakeholder & Relationship Management

  • Manage competing priorities and expectations across multiple stakeholder groups, building trust through fostering mutual understanding, delivering consistently and communicating transparently.
  • Represent the team's roadmap, capacity and risks in cross-functional planning and prioritization discussions.

3. Technical Engagement & Decision-Making

  • Drive technical discussions and design reviews, with enough depth to understand the implications of key decisions on reliability, scalability and production outcomes.
  • Partner with engineers on architecture and design choices, asking the right questions rather than dictating solutions.
  • Ensure the team's technical decisions are well understood by, and defensible to, other stakeholders.

4. AI-Enabled Ways of Working

  • Model and champion effective use of AI tools across the team's day-to-day work, including AI-assisted research, administrative workflows, and code generation.
  • Help the team develop good judgment about how to balance the productivity gains AI can bring against the risks it introduces.
  • Continuously look for ways AI tooling can improve team efficiency, code quality, and decision-making, and share what's working with peers.
  • Manage effectively through the major changes AI is bringing to the industry.

5. Delivery & Operational Rigor

  • Own delivery of the team's roadmap balancing feature work, technical debt and reliability commitments.
  • Establish and maintain appropriate quality, testing and monitoring practices.
  • Provide clear, proactive communication on progress, risks and blockers to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Define metrics as needed and develop an understanding of why we did or didn’t hit our targets.

Qualifications & Skills (experience / depth)

Experience

  • 5+ years working as a software engineer. Some of that experience should be in the ML sphere.
  • This should not be your first time managing and we’d prefer at least 4 years of experience managing engineers directly in an ML focused domain.

Technical & AI Fluency

  • Comfortable engaging in technical discussions on architecture, data flows, and system design.
  • Demonstrable experience using AI tools in a professional capacity for research, administration and code generation with a clear point of view on how to use them responsibly and cost-effectively.
  • Strong knowledge of software development best practices, cloud computing platforms, big data technologies, MLOps toolkits, and SLO-driven reliability management.
  • Experience working with at least one of Databricks, Spark, Airflow, Vertex and the GCP technology stack in general is preferred.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

  • Strong track record managing relationships with a diverse set of technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to communicate clearly across audiences and influence without authority.
  • Comfortable navigating competing priorities and pushing back constructively when needed.

Leadership

  • Genuine care for engineer growth and development, with experience giving structured feedback and building career paths.
  • Ability to build trust and psychological safety within the team while holding a high bar for output and accountability.

title: Senior AI Engineer - Search & Recommendation - Patient Team (x/f/m)
description:
Join our mission, join Doctolib! 

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join the Patient team in Paris. 

The Patient domain sits at the heart of Doctolib's mission: ensuring everyone has better access to the care they need, receives better care from health professionals, and can actively prevent health problems to improve their wellbeing.

You’ll design the search and recommendation engines behind our health companion, helping 100M patients across Europe instantly navigate to the exact care they need while delivering trusted, curated insights at every step. The retrieval and recommendation architecture you own will directly shape how relevant, fast, and trustworthy that experience is for every one of them.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design and build the production search & recommendation architecture: full retrieval, ranking, reranking pipeline with standard and off-the-shelf components (vector search, semantic retrieval, LLM/managed rerankers).
  • Establish strong baselines first (prompts, RAG, model selection) before reaching for custom ML.
  • Build evaluation and observability into every stage, with offline and online evaluation.
  • Set up the data/event feedback loops that drive iteration and feed deeper ML later.
  • Improve search relevance and ranking on Patient facing products , raising result quality
  • Own production quality: latency reliability, monitoring, and maintainability.
  • Partner with ML Engineers and collaborate closely with PMs and SWEs to define, build, and ship AI-powered features that deliver measurable value to users and the business. 


Who you are

Before you read on:  if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You could be our next team mate if you have:

  1. Production deployment: ability to ship algorithms to production (ECS-based service on AWS)
  2. Strong analytical mindset: result-oriented,  patient-first approach
  3. Significant experience as a Software or/and AI engineer shipping search or recommendation systems to production. 
  4. Hands-on experience building end-to-end retrieval: ranking,  reranking pipelines and familiar with nDCG, MAP, Recall@k, MRR
  5. AI-engineering proficiency: turning foundation models and off-the-shelf components into production systems: embeddings & vector search, semantic retrieval, RAG, LLM-based or managed rerankers (e.g. Vertex AI). You can succeed without training a model from scratch
  6. Architecture-first approach: you build the system, baselines, evals, and feedback loops with standard tooling before reaching for custom ML, and know when to partner with ML Engineers to break a ceiling
  7. Evaluation & observability built into every stage (retrieval, ranker, reranker) — offline and online eval, A/B testing, position-bias handling, monitoring
  8. Production deployment — ability to ship reliable, low-latency services to production (hundreds-of-ms SLAs), with care for data quality and long-term maintainability

 

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • Experience at a B2C marketplace (e-commerce, hospitality, travel)
  • Additional ML methodologies: pattern mining, recommendation systems, experimentation, or causal inference
  • Have experience with search engines or information retrieval concepts
  • Have exposure to learning-to-rank or feature engineering (for breaking ceilings later, alongside ML Engineers)
  • Have experience in a healthcare or other regulated domain (GDPR / HDS)

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single, fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.
  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.
  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.
  • We also invest in open, applied AI research. For example, our DoctoBERT project introduces open-source medical language models trained for French clinical text, with applications in named entity recognition, classification, and retrieval. Read the DoctoBERT practical guide to learn more about how we bring deep AI research into practical healthcare applications.
Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children
  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT
  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care
  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy
  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib
  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class
  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription
  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth
  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave, and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib
  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

 

The interview process 

  • A first interview with a member of the Talent Acquisition team
  • A coding interview
  • An agentics system design 
  • A behavioural interview 
  • Reference check 

 

Job details

  • Permanent position
  • Full Time 
  • Workplace: Levallois
  • Start date : As soon as possible

 

 

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g. pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process. 

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

Expected experience

  • 10+ years in leading IT operations teams — You have operated L1, L2, and L3 support as SRE, platform reliability or infrastructure organisations, with the people and the providers reporting to you

  • Infrastructure in depth — has deep infrastructure knowledge, and what is required for smooth business operations: telemetry, redundancies, backups, etc.

  • Incident management, with post-incident reviews that led to real changes in the system and in the organisation

  • Regulated financial services, or another environment where an external body audits operational evidence.

  • Has worked through a managed service provider and can set standards they do not personally execute

  • Comfortable operating in a complex, multi-stakeholder programme where scope and ownership are still being established across parallel workstreams

Valuable, not required

  • LLM or agentic system operations: eval harnesses, drift detection, trajectory analysis, prompt and model versioning treated as change types

  • Core banking or payments exposure, particularly scheme gateway integration

What This Role Is Not

  • Not a platform architect. A separate role owns agentic platform design and build

  • Not an on-call engineer. You will not carry a client pager; out-of-hours operations are run by a third party

  • Not a service delivery manager. This is engineering judgement applied to readiness, not ITSM process administration

title: Technisch Support Engineer
description: Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan. Steeds meer woningen worden verwarmd met onze warmtepompen. En dat betekent dat we ook steeds meer installaties moeten monitoren, klanten ondersteunen en technische problemen oplossen. Daarom zoeken we een Technical Support Engineer die ons support team komt versterken. Je helpt klanten en monteurs bij technische vragen, onderzoekt storingen en zorgt dat onze warmtepompen optimaal blijven functioneren. Tegelijkertijd kijk je verder dan het probleem van vandaag. Waarom ontstaat een storing? Hoe kunnen we die in de toekomst voorkomen? En hoe kunnen we onze support slimmer organiseren? Je lost dus niet alleen problemen op, maar helpt ons ook om onze producten en service steeds beter te maken. Wat ga je doen? Als Technical Support Engineer ben je een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor technische vragen over onze warmtepompen. Je combineert technisch inzicht met klantcontact en werkt nauw samen met onze service-, product- en engineeringteams. Je helpt klanten en monteurs bij technische problemen Je analyseert storingen en zoekt uit wat er aan de hand is, bijvoorbeeld door systeemdata en instellingen te onderzoeken. Je ondersteunt klanten telefonisch en per mail bij technische vragen en problemen. Je helpt installateurs en servicemonteurs bij het oplossen van technische problemen. Je past waar nodig instellingen van warmtepompen aan om hun prestaties te optimaliseren. Je schakelt servicemonteurs in wanneer een probleem niet op afstand kan worden opgelost en zorgt voor een goede overdracht. Je helpt onze support steeds slimmer en beter te maken Je herkent terugkerende problemen en denkt mee over structurele oplossingen. Je maakt en verbetert technische documentatie, handleidingen en werkinstructies. Je deelt inzichten uit de praktijk met onze product- en engineeringteams, zodat we onze warmtepompen verder kunnen verbeteren. Je denkt mee over hoe we onze processen en systemen kunnen verbeteren en automatiseren. Je komt terecht in een groeiend team waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Dat betekent dat je veel kunt leren, verantwoordelijkheid krijgt en zelf invloed hebt op hoe we werken. Wat breng je mee? We zoeken iemand die technisch nieuwsgierig is, graag problemen oplost en energie krijgt van het helpen van anderen. Je hoeft nog geen expert in warmtepompen te zijn. We leren je graag hoe onze systemen werken. Wat we belangrijk vinden: Je hebt een technische hbo-opleiding afgerond, bijvoorbeeld in werktuigbouwkunde, elektrotechniek of een vergelijkbare richting. Je hebt technisch en analytisch inzicht en vindt het leuk om uit te zoeken hoe systemen werken. Je communiceert duidelijk en prettig, ook met mensen die minder technische kennis hebben. Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands. Je bent zelfstandig, leergierig en neemt initiatief wanneer je ziet dat iets beter kan. Je vindt het leuk om zowel met techniek als met mensen bezig te zijn. Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar. Mooi meegenomen, maar zeker geen vereiste: Ervaring met technische support, troubleshooting of klantcontact. Kennis van warmtepompen, installatietechniek of andere technische systemen. Ervaring met Python, data-analyse of het automatiseren van processen. Wat bieden wij jou? Een salaris van €3.000 tot €4.000 bruto per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van je ervaring. 27 vakantiedagen. Een pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding. De mogelijkheid om mee te delen in het succes van DeWarmte via onze Stock Appreciation Rights (SAR). Veel ruimte om te leren, jezelf te ontwikkelen en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Een informele werkomgeving met korte lijnen en collega's die graag samenwerken. De mogelijkheid om deels vanuit huis te werken, naast onze gezamenlijke kantoordagen. En natuurlijk de kans om bij te dragen aan de energietransitie met producten die we zelf ontwikkelen en verbeteren. Zin om mee te bouwen? Bij DeWarmte houden we van mensen die initiatief nemen, nieuwsgierig zijn en samen dingen beter willen maken. Je hoeft niet alles al te kunnen. Als je graag leert, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van techniek en het helpen van mensen, maken we graag kennis met je. title: Financial Director
description: Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan. We groeien hard. Met een flinke groeispurt in het aantal aanvragen, een groeiende operatie in Nederland en onze eerste stappen in Duitsland breekt een nieuwe fase aan. Daarom zoeken we een Financial Director die onderdeel wordt van ons Management Team en de volledige verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor Finance. Je wordt ons vierde MT-lid en werkt nauw samen met onze CEO, COO en People Director aan de verdere groei van DeWarmte. Je begint niet vanaf nul. Onze founders hebben een sterke financiële basis neergezet, met een geïntegreerd financieel model dat zich al tijdens meerdere financieringsrondes en due diligence-trajecten heeft bewezen. Nu zoeken we iemand die daarop voortbouwt en Finance naar een volgend niveau brengt. En daar krijg je alle ruimte voor. Je ontwikkelt je eigen visie op de financiële organisatie, stelt een financiële roadmap op en bouwt een schaalbaar team. Je vertaalt cijfers naar betere beslissingen, daagt bestaande aannames uit en helpt ons de juiste keuzes te maken terwijl we groeien. We zoeken iemand die strategisch denkt, maar ook graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen steekt. Die het grotere plaatje ziet, maar net zo makkelijk de diepte ingaat om een financieel vraagstuk op te lossen. Wat ga je doen? Als Financial Director ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor Finance én denk je als MT-lid mee over de koers van DeWarmte. Je bouwt voort op een sterke financiële basis en zorgt dat onze financiële organisatie klaar is voor de volgende groeifase. Financiële strategie en business performance Je ontwikkelt de financiële strategie en roadmap en vertaalt onze groeiambities naar concrete plannen en doelstellingen. Je bent een strategische sparringpartner voor de founders en het MT. Je daagt aannames uit, beoordeelt kansen en helpt bij belangrijke investerings- en bedrijfsbeslissingen. Je vertaalt financiële en operationele data naar inzichten die onze prestaties, winstgevendheid en besluitvorming verbeteren. Financiële planning, control en financiering Je neemt het eigenaarschap over ons geïntegreerde financiële model en bent verantwoordelijk voor budgettering, forecasting, scenarioanalyses en managementrapportages. Je stuurt op cashflow, liquiditeit en werkkapitaal en zorgt dat we onze groei financieel kunnen blijven ondersteunen. Je leidt de financiële voorbereiding van financieringsrondes en due diligence-trajecten en verzorgt de rapportages aan aandeelhouders. Je waarborgt betrouwbare financiële administratie, rapportages en compliance, inclusief de verdere inrichting van onze Duitse activiteiten. Bouwen aan een schaalbare finance-organisatie Je ontwikkelt en leidt ons Finance-team, te beginnen met een Financial Controller, en stuurt onze externe financiële partners aan. Je verbetert processen en systemen en benut automatisering en AI om Finance slimmer en efficiënter te organiseren. Je zorgt voor heldere financiële verantwoordelijkheden en controles, zonder onnodige bureaucratie. Je combineert dus strategie met uitvoering. De ene dag bespreek je met het MT de langetermijnstrategie, de andere dag duik je zelf in een forecast, werk je aan een financieringsvraagstuk of verbeter je een proces. Je voelt je comfortabel op beide niveaus. Wie zoeken we? We zoeken een Financial Director die financiële expertise combineert met ondernemerschap, leiderschap en een sterk gevoel voor de business. Wat je meebrengt: Ruime ervaring in senior financiële functies, bij voorkeur binnen een snelgroeiend bedrijf of een scale-up. Een sterke achtergrond in zowel financial control als financial planning & analysis (FP&A). Ervaring met het vertalen van bedrijfsstrategie naar financiële plannen en concrete resultaten. Sterke financiële modelleervaardigheden en een goed begrip van P&L, balans, cashflow en de operationele factoren die deze beïnvloeden. Ervaring in een hardware-, productie-, energie-, logistieke of andere werkkapitaalintensieve omgeving is een groot voordeel. Ervaring met financiering, fundraising, kredietfaciliteiten of due diligence is een plus. Het vermogen om een financiële functie en team op te bouwen, zonder zelf de aansluiting met de dagelijkse praktijk te verliezen. Affiniteit met technologie, automatisering en AI. Je beheerst zowel het Nederlands als het Engels op professioneel niveau. Minstens zo belangrijk vinden we hoe je werkt: Je denkt als ondernemer. Je kijkt verder dan de cijfers en begrijpt hoe Finance bijdraagt aan het succes van het hele bedrijf. Je hebt een eigen visie. Je brengt ideeën mee, daagt de status quo uit en durft de founders en andere MT-leden kritisch tegen te spreken. Je bouwt voort op wat goed werkt. Je neemt de tijd om de business en bestaande processen te begrijpen, voordat je bepaalt wat beter kan. Je neemt eigenaarschap. Je wacht niet tot iemand je vertelt wat er moet gebeuren, maar ziet kansen, stelt prioriteiten en komt in actie. Je combineert strategie met executie. Je krijgt energie van richting bepalen, maar net zo goed van zelf dingen voor elkaar krijgen. Je voelt je thuis in een scale-up. Je houdt van snelheid, kunt omgaan met verandering en onzekerheid en hebt geen volledig uitgewerkt plan nodig om vooruitgang te boeken. Wat wij bieden Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €7.500 en €9.000 op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van je ervaring. Een sleutelrol binnen ons Management Team, met veel verantwoordelijkheid en directe invloed op de toekomst van DeWarmte. De ruimte om je eigen visie te realiseren en een financiële organisatie op te bouwen die met ons meegroeit. Deelname aan ons SAR-programma , waarmee je financieel meeprofiteert van de groei en het succes van DeWarmte. Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak. Iedere dag een gezamenlijke lunch op kantoor. Regelmatige teamuitjes en borrels, waaronder onze jaarlijkse stranddag en wintersport. Een informele, ondernemende werkomgeving met korte lijnen, ambitieuze collega's en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Waarom DeWarmte? Een echte plek aan tafel. Als vierde lid van ons Management Team heb je directe invloed op onze strategie, prioriteiten en toekomst. De kans om iets op te bouwen. Er ligt een sterke financiële basis, maar jij krijgt de ruimte en verantwoordelijkheid om de financiële organisatie, het team en de roadmap voor de komende jaren vorm te geven. Een bedrijf midden in een belangrijke groeifase. In een fase van groeiende activiteiten en internationale ambities stap je in op een moment waarop sterk financieel leiderschap echt het verschil kan maken. Een ondernemende, hands-on cultuur. We nemen snel beslissingen, geven mensen veel verantwoordelijkheid en zoeken continu naar manieren om beter te worden. We waarderen mensen die kritisch meedenken, elkaar helpen en plannen omzetten in actie. Een missie die ertoe doet. We bouwen technologie die de energietransitie versnelt. Met jouw werk help je duurzame verwarming voor steeds meer huishoudens bereikbaar te maken. Klaar om mee te bouwen? We zoeken iemand die meer wil dan verantwoordelijk zijn voor de cijfers. Iemand die wil meebouwen aan een bedrijf, richting wil geven en blijvende impact wil maken. Herken jij jezelf hierin? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Compensation: €7.5K – €9K per month • €7.5K – €9K per month Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Managing Principal - Software Engineering & Architecture H/F
description:
Managing Principal - Software Engineering & Architecture H/F

Location: Paris (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

 

Nous recherchons un(e) Managing Principal - Software Engineering & Architecture pour piloter et développer notre expertise en software engineering, tout en accompagnant nos clients dans leurs transformations les plus complexes.

Ce rôle de leadership technologique, s'articule autour de trois dimensions essentielles : Engineering Leadership, Architecture & Transformation et Client Development.

En tant que Software Engineering Chapter Lead, vous définirez les orientations techniques, renforcerez les standards d'ingénierie et accompagnerez le développement de notre communauté de Tech Leads, d'architectes et d'ingénieurs seniors.

Vous aurez une forte proximité avec les technologies et la réalisation des projets, tout en collaborant avec les décideurs de haut niveau chez nos clients afin de structurer leurs transformations, d'influencer leurs choix technologiques et de développer de nouvelles opportunités pour Capco.

 

Ce que vous ferez

Engineering & Chapter Leadership

  • Piloter et développer notre communauté software engineering en définissant les standards, les principes et les bonnes pratiques.
  • Accompagner, coacher et faire monter en compétences les tech leads, les architectes et les ingénieurs seniors, tout en contribuant au développement des expertises.
  • Promouvoir une culture d'excellence en ingénierie, de responsabilisation technique et d'amélioration continue.

Hands-on Architecture & Engineering

  • Apporter une expertise technique approfondie et opérationnelle sur les technologies backend, notamment Java
  • Analyser en profondeur les architectures et les conceptions techniques, challenger les choix technologiques et orienter les équipes vers des solutions pragmatiques.
  • Accompagner les initiatives de modernisation technologique autour des architectures cloud-native, des systèmes distribués, des API, des microservices et des architectures événementielles (event-driven).
  • Garantir que les solutions répondent aux exigences de sécurité, de scalabilité, de résilience, de performance et d'observabilité.

Client Advisory & Business Development

  • Développer des relations de confiance avec les CTO, CIO, Heads of Engineering, Heads of Architecture et responsables Product de nos clients.
  • Challenger les approches de manière constructive et influencer les décisions stratégiques de nos clients.
  • Contribuer à l'élaboration des propositions commerciales et aux soutenances, notamment en définissant les approches, les architectures, les équipes et les modèles de delivery.
  • Participer au développement des offres et du portefeuille clients de Capco dans les domaines du Software Engineering, de l'Architecture, du Cloud et de la modernisation technologique.

 

Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes un(e) leader expérimenté(e) en ingénierie logicielle et en technologie, capable de conjuguer une expertise technique approfondie, une vision architecturale, des compétences en leadership et une forte orientation client.

Votre parcours peut notamment vous avoir amené(e) à occuper des fonctions de Principal Engineer, Principal Tech Lead, Engineering Lead, Software Architect ou Head of Engineering.

Vous disposez des compétences et expériences suivantes :

  • Une expérience confirmée dans l'encadrement et le développement d'ingénieurs seniors, de Tech Leads et/ou d'architectes.
  • Une expertise approfondie en conception logicielle, systèmes distribués, architectures cloud-native et pratiques modernes d'ingénierie. Notamment avec l’usage de l’IA appliqués au Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC).
  • D'excellentes compétences en communication, en français comme en anglais.

Une expérience dans les services financiers, le secteur bancaire ou les paiements constitue un atout.

 

Pourquoi rejoindre Capco?

Capco est un cabinet de conseil international, spécialisé dans les services financiers.

Fondé en 1998, le cabinet compte aujourd’hui plus de 7 000 collaborateurs dans 36 bureaux à travers le monde, dont 160 à Paris.

Challenger reconnu face aux grands noms du conseil, Capco se distingue par sa double expertise métier et technologique, au service de la stratégie comme de l’exécution.

Notre promesse : accompagner la transformation de nos clients dans un monde en constante mutation réglementaire, technologique et opérationnel.

Nous intervenons à l’intersection du business, de la réglementation et de la tech, en mobilisant des équipes pluridisciplinaires, expérimentées et engagées.

 

Nos Marqueurs Distinctifs

  • Une spécialisation sectorielle forte Nous apportons à nos clients une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux métiers, en particulier dans la banque, les marchés de capitaux et l’énergie.
  • Une approche collaborative et sur mesure Nous intégrons les équipes clients, adaptons nos méthodes à leur culture et co-construisons des solutions concrètes et opérationnelles.
  • L’excellence comme exigence Notre ambition est d’obtenir des résultats mesurables et durables pour nos clients – et de toujours viser la valeur ajoutée.
  • Un esprit “One Capco” Nos équipes collaborent à l’échelle internationale pour mobiliser les meilleures expertises et partager les bonnes pratiques.
  • Une culture entrepreneuriale et inclusive L’innovation, l’initiative et le mérite sont au cœur de notre modèle. Nous valorisons les idées, la diversité et le progrès collectif.

 

Nos expertises s’articulent autour de 6 métiers complémentaires

  • Stratégie & Transformation
  • Finance, Risque & Conformité
  • Product, Innovation & Design
  • Data & Analytics
  • Conseil Tech (Advisory)
  • Engineering (Delivery)

 

Chez Capco, nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement de travail international centré sur l’innovation et la création de valeur pour nos clients bancaires et assuranciels
  • Un parcours de formation continu adapté à vos besoins, pour acquérir de nouvelles compétences et développer une réelle expertise
  • Une organisation de travail hybride (charte télétravail de 2 jours par semaine)
  • Une rémunération compétitive avec un bonus lié à la performance
  • Un PEE avec un abondement de 2903€ par an
  • Une culture d’entreprise entrepreneuriale, inclusive et méritocratique, de nouveau certifiée Great Place To Work
  • Des initiatives pour construire le Capco de demain :
    • #BeYourselfAtWork
    • Woman@capco
    • RSE (forfait mobilité durable, jour de solidarité, etc.)
    • Des communautés métiers, sportives et culturelles

Chez Capco Paris, handicap visible ou invisible, parcours atypique ou classique, toutes les candidatures sont les bienvenues et seront traitées avec équité.

description:
DIE ROLLE

Für unsere Kunden aus dem Banken- und Versicherungsumfeld suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n (Senior) Consultant / Business Analyst mit Fokus auf Kundenprozesse und CRM. Du gestaltest gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen, IT und Projektteams, wie Finanzinstitute ihre Kundinnen und Kunden über den gesamten Lebenszyklus betreuen: vom Onboarding über die laufende Kundenbeziehung bis zum Offboarding.

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Business, Technologie und Daten. Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse und Systeme, übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in klare Spezifikationen und begleitest die Umsetzung in CRM- und Client-Lifecycle-Management-Lösungen. Dabei denkst du dich schnell in neue Themen und Kundenorganisationen ein und bringst Projekte proaktiv voran.

DEIN CAPCO-ALLTAG

  • Du analysierst Kundenprozesse entlang des Client Lifecycle, z. B. Onboarding, KYC, Stammdatenpflege, Kundenbetreuung und Offboarding, und identifizierst Verbesserungs- und Automatisierungspotenziale.
  • Du erhebst, strukturierst und priorisierst fachliche und technische Anforderungen und übersetzt sie in Use Cases, User Stories und Spezifikationen.
  • Du modellierst Ist- und Soll-Prozesse mit BPMN sowie Daten- und Systemzusammenhänge mit UML und schaffst so eine gemeinsame Sprache für Fachbereich und IT.
  • Du begleitest die Einführung, Weiterentwicklung und Integration von CRM-Lösungen (z. B. Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365), von der Konzeption über Test und Abnahme bis zum Go-live.
  • Du moderierst Workshops mit Stakeholdern aus Business, IT und Operations, zeigst Optionen und Abhängigkeiten auf und bereitest Entscheidungsvorlagen für das Management vor.
  • Du stellst die Nachvollziehbarkeit von den Geschäftszielen über die Anforderungen bis zur umgesetzten Lösung sicher.
  • Als Senior übernimmst du Verantwortung für Teilprojekte oder Workstreams und gibst dein Wissen an jüngere Kolleginnen und Kollegen weiter.

DEIN CAPCO-FIT

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Beratungserfahrung, idealerweise in einer Management- oder IT-Beratung mit Fokus auf Financial Services.
  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit CRM-Themen und -Tools, insbesondere in Projekten zur Einführung, Weiterentwicklung oder Integration von CRM-Systemen.
  • Fundierte Branchenkenntnisse im Banken- oder Versicherungsumfeld, vor allem rund um Kundenprozesse und Client Lifecycle Management.
  • Solide Methodenkompetenz in der Business-Analyse: Anforderungsmanagement, Prozessmodellierung mit BPMN und UML sowie Erfahrung mit agilen und klassischen Projektmethoden.
  • Nachweisbare Projekterfahrung an der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereich und IT.
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du arbeitest dich zügig in neue Themen, Systeme und Kundenumfelder ein und lieferst früh Mehrwert.
  • Du bist motiviert, proaktiv und lösungsorientiert, übernimmst Verantwortung und überzeugst durch klare, strukturierte Kommunikation.
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C1/C2) sind ein Muss, sehr gute Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.

BONUSPUNKTE FÜR

  • Erfahrung mit regulatorischen Anforderungen im Kundenumfeld, z. B. KYC/AML, MiFID II bzw. FIDLEG oder Datenschutz (DSG/DSGVO).
  • Erfahrung mit angrenzenden Themen wie Customer Data Management, Omnichannel, Marketing Automation oder Customer Experience.
  • Zertifizierungen in Business-Analyse oder CRM (z. B. IREB CPRE, CBAP, Salesforce-Zertifizierungen).
  • Erfahrung in agilen Setups (Scrum, SAFe) als Business Analyst oder Product Owner.

 

Inklusion bei Capco

Wir setzen uns für einen barrierefreien und zugänglichen Bewerbungsprozess ein. Wenn Du in irgendeiner Phase Unterstützung oder Anpassungen benötigst, lass es uns bitte wissen – wir helfen gerne weiter. Wir schätzen unterschiedliche Perspektiven und Hintergründe. Bei Capco glauben wir daran, dass Individualität eine Stärke ist. Unsere #BeYourselfAtWork-Kultur fördert Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit – und prägt, wie wir täglich mit unseren Kundinnen und Kunden sowie miteinander arbeiten.

Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next. This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do. Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem Win the first deal.
